jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
***Maximize your potential. Minimize your footprint.***

Nortek Data Center Cooling builds the systems that keep modern data centers running — from liquid cooling to large‑scale air solutions. Our work supports some of the world’s most demanding AI and hyperscale environments, and we solve those challenges with engineering depth and practical execution.

We keep things simple here. We communicate early, stay close to the details, and follow through. When issues come up, we address them directly, not with layers of process. Customers count on us because we do what we say and we keep projects moving.

Our culture is hands‑on and collaborative. People take ownership, move quickly, and help each other. If you like working with teammates who are straightforward and accountable, you’ll feel at home.

With the backing of Madison Air, we have the scale, stability, and manufacturing footprint to support complex, high‑growth programs.

**Position Summary**

The Program Manager serves as the day-to-day cross-functional integrator and accountability mechanism for customer commitments on assigned programs at Nortek Data Center Cooling. This role drives flawless execution across the full program lifecycle—from opportunity identification through completion of product commissioning.

Reporting to the Vice President of Program Management, the Program Manager coordinates Engineering, Test, Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Commercial, Finance, and Service teams to meet schedule, cost, quality, and customer commitments, while these functions continue to own execution within their respective areas. This is a hands-on execution role accountable for program-level P&L execution and customer commitments—delivering revenue, margin, cost, cash, schedule, change orders, and overall program performance. Success requires strong critical-path management, cross-functional influence, and clear communication with both internal stakeholders and external customers. The Program Manager maintains direct customer contact on program execution and is accountable for the financial health of the program, while the Sales Account Executive remains the primary customer contact and owns customer communication, negotiation, and pricing strategy.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Program Execution & Schedule Management**
-------------------------------------------

* Own end-to-end execution of assigned customer programs from opportunity identification through completion of product commissioning.
* Build, maintain, and drive the integrated program schedule with a relentless focus on critical-path items and dependencies across engineering, procurement, fabrication, assembly, test, shipping, installation, and commissioning.
* Lead recurring program cadence meetings, ensuring clear ownership, decisions, and follow-through on action items.
* Coordinate engineering release, drawing approval cycles, long-lead procurement, fabrication, assembly, testing, customer acceptance, installation, and commissioning milestones per the standardized program workflow.
* Escalate schedule risks and cross-functional roadblocks promptly, with proposed mitigation paths.

**Customer Coordination & Communication**
-----------------------------------------

* Maintain direct customer contact on program execution matters, while the Sales Account Executive remains the primary customer point of contact and owns customer communication and negotiation.
* Provide clear, proactive, and honest program status communications—schedule, milestones, risks, and change orders—to internal leadership and, in coordination with the Sales Account Executive, to the customer.
* Build strong working relationships with customer counterparts; understand their pain points, priorities, and success metrics.
* Represent the voice of the customer inside Nortek DCC and the voice of Nortek DCC to the customer with balance and integrity.

**Program-Level P&L and Contract Management**
---------------------------------------------

* Accountable for the financial health of the program and for program-level P&L execution and customer commitments—delivering revenue, margin, cost, cash, schedule, change orders, and overall program performance against the approved deal model and budget. Sales remains responsible for pricing strategy.
* Manage change orders end-to-end—identify scope changes, quantify impact, and drive internal approvals and execution—partnering with the Sales Account Executive, who leads customer negotiation.
* Monitor contract obligations, deliverables, and customer commitments; ensure Nortek DCC meets its obligations.
* Proactively identify risks to program profitability and partner with Commercial, Finance, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and Service to mitigate them.

**Risk Management**
-------------------

* Apply the standardized risk identification, escalation, and mitigation process to every assigned program.
* Maintain a live program risk register with clear ownership, mitigation actions, due dates, and status.
* Drive critical risks to closure on time, targeting 90%+ on-time closure across the program portfolio.
* Escalate top risks to the VP of Program Management with recommended actions; ensure high-risk issues have documented mitigation plans and appropriate visibility.

**Installation, Commissioning & Service Coordination**
------------------------------------------------------

* Ensure Service has visibility to installation schedules and customer requirements.
* Ensure field resources, parts, and support plans are aligned with program commitments.
* Coordinate and escalate warranty issues, field modifications, or customer concerns.
* Track financial and customer impacts associated with post-delivery issues.

* Remain engaged whenever there are material issues impacting customer commitments, schedule, economics, or customer satisfaction; support formal handoff to Service when programs are running smoothly.
* Service continues to own service

jobs.title: Implementation Program Manager - Investment Management Technology (Required)
jobs.description:
**Implementation Program Manager - Investment Management Technology (Required)**

**Location:** Remote - US

**Type**: Full-time, Permanent

**Travel:** As needed, approximately once per month to client locations in California

**About Cutter:**

At Cutter Associates, we empower the world’s leading asset managers and asset owners with the intelligence they need to stay ahead. For nearly 30 years, and with a global presence, we’ve combined expert consulting with proprietary research and industry benchmarking to help top-tier investment firms make smarter, faster decisions. Our global team is known for its deep domain expertise, collaborative spirit, and relentless curiosity. As we expand into new markets and capabilities, now is the perfect time to grow your career with a company that values insight, innovation, and impact.

As we expand our reach and deepen our impact, we're seeking an experienced Project / Program Manager to lead complex investment management technology implementations for institutional asset management clients. This is a full-time, permanent position supporting multiple consulting engagements across our practices.

The ideal candidate brings deep knowledge of investment management systems and business processes, a strong track record of leading enterprise technology implementations, and the ability to engage confidently with senior executives. This individual will oversee project delivery, manage vendor relationships, and guide clients through critical decisions to ensure successful outcomes.

**Role and Responsibilities:**

* Lead large-scale investment management technology implementations, overseeing project planning, execution, governance, and delivery.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, including executive leadership and steering committees.
* Manage third-party technology vendors, ensuring accountability for deliverables, timelines, and commitments.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams, including client stakeholders, vendors, and Cutter consulting resources.
* Develop and maintain project plans, status reports, risk assessments, and executive-level presentations.
* Facilitate critical project decisions, proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and opportunities for improvement.
* Support multiple client engagements and collaborate across Cutter's consulting practices as business needs evolve.

**Qualifications:**

**Required**

* 15+ years of experience in investment management technology, consulting, or transformation, including significant project/program management experience.
* Proven experience leading complex investment management system implementations for asset managers, asset owners, or institutional investment organizations.
* Strong understanding of front-, middle-, and back-office investment management workflows and technology platforms.
* Demonstrated experience managing third-party vendors, implementation partners, and cross-functional delivery teams.
* Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder management skills, including experience presenting to steering committees and boards.
* Strong program governance, project planning, risk management, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to operate independently, manage competing priorities, and provide strategic guidance while remaining actively involved in delivery.

**Preferred**

* Experience implementing or overseeing platforms such as Charles River, Eagle, Clearwater, Aladdin, SimCorp, or comparable investment management systems.
* Prior consulting experience supporting institutional investment management clients.
* Experience managing enterprise-wide technology modernization or platform transformation initiatives.
* PMP or equivalent project management certification.

**Why Cutter:**

At Cutter Associates, we believe people do their best work when they’re trusted, supported, and empowered to thrive - wherever they are.

* **Established credibility, entrepreneurial spirit** – Founded in 1998 and backed by Nomura Research Institute (NRI), we blend the stability of a global research and technology powerhouse with the agility of a small, fast-moving firm.
* **Global reach** - We partner with leading investment firms across North America, EMEA, and APAC, giving you meaningful exposure and exciting challenges.
* **Fully remote, fully connected** - We’re a remote-first company with a flexible work model and a deeply collaborative culture.
* **Growth-focused** - From client exposure and internal knowledge groups to tailored learning paths, we invest in your development from day one.
* **Performance-driven, people-first** - We offer competitive pay, bonuses, profit sharing, and benefits that support your whole self.
* **A culture that values people** - We take pride in our thoughtful, collaborative, and inclusive environment. We’re a team of individuals who care deeply - about our work, our clients, and each other.

Whether you’re launching your consulting career or bringing decades of experience, Cutter is a place where you can thrive.

**Benefits at a Glance:**

Our benefits vary slightly by location but are designed to support your health, financial wellness, and life outside of work. Highlights include:

* Competitive salary with annual performance bonus and profit-sharing opportunity
* 401(k) match (U.S.) or Superannuation contributions (Australia)
* A generous paid time off package that includes vacation days, sick leave, company holidays, and time off for volunteering
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance (U.S.), or regionally competitive coverage (U.K. and Australia)
* Long-term disability and life insurance fully paid by the company (U.S.)
* Flexible work model - fully remote with optional access to co-working spaces or offices
* Global collaboration and travel opportunities across North America, EMEA, and APAC.

jobs.title: OE Collision Network Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

**Be part of a team that makes a real difference.**

Job Description :

**This is a full-time remote position that can be located anywhere in the U.S.**

As an OE Collision Network Implementation Manager, you will help support certified collision repair networks for leading automotive manufacturers. In this customer-facing role, you'll review applications, verify shop equipment and training requirements, conduct virtual audits, and guide collision repair facilities on maintaining their certification status. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with collision repair, estimating, production management, or automotive service experience who wants to leverage their industry knowledge in a technology-driven, remote work environment.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Review and process applications from collision repair facilities seeking certification within manufacturer-sponsored collision networks.
* Verify customer-submitted tooling, equipment, and training requirements against network standards.
* Conduct virtual audits and customer meetings using video conferencing tools to validate equipment and compliance requirements.
* Manage annual certification renewals and ongoing compliance reviews for existing network members.
* Maintain accurate records and documentation within Salesforce and other company systems.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for collision repair facilities regarding certification requirements and network participation.
* Partner with internal teams to support network growth and customer success initiatives.
* Assist with other projects and operational initiatives as assigned.

**Skills and Abilities**

* Working knowledge of collision repair shop operations, equipment, and tooling.
* Strong customer service and communication skills with the ability to conduct virtual meetings confidently.
* Ability to review information carefully and ensure accuracy and compliance.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
* Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM platforms preferred.
* Strong organizational and time management skills in a remote work environment.
* Ability to build credibility and rapport with collision repair professionals and automotive industry customers.
* Comfortable learning new systems, processes, and technologies.

Qualifications:

* High school diploma or equivalent required; some college coursework preferred.
* Approximately 1-3 years of experience in a collision repair, automotive service, estimating, production management, or related environment preferred.
* Collision repair shop experience strongly preferred.
* Experience as an estimator, production manager, shop manager, collision technician, mechanic, or similar automotive professional is highly desirable.
* Experience working with collision networks or OEM/OE-certified repair programs is a plus.
* ICAR certification preferred but not required.
* Experience using Salesforce or comparable business systems is a plus.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States.

Benefits:

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full-time or part-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $27.00 - $36.00 per hour, and will be based on a number of additional factors including skills, experience, and education.

*The Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.*

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and underrepresented minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Corporate PMO
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

FedSync is seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead its corporate Program Management Office (PMO). This is an enterprise-level role overseeing a portfolio of federal contracts, not a single project. The Senior Program Manager sets program management standards across the company, holds portfolio-level P&L accountability and mentors the Program and Project Managers who run individual contracts.

The role reports to executive leadership and partners with Business Development, Contracts, Finance and HR to shape FedSync's growth. It is a step up for a proven federal Program Manager ready to move from leading one program to leading the program function. This position is remote with quarterly travel requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the corporate PMO and provide executive oversight of all FedSync federal contracts and task orders.
* Establish and maintain enterprise program management standards, processes, tools, templates and governance.
* Own portfolio-level financial performance: revenue, margin, backlog, funding and forecasting.
* Conduct monthly program management reviews (PMRs) with program leads; identify risks early and drive corrective action.
* Serve as executive point of contact for government customers and escalate or resolve contract-level issues.
* Recruit, develop and mentor Program and Project Managers; build a bench of Key Personnel for future bids.
* Partner with Business Development on capture and proposals: solution design, staffing plans, pricing input and past performance.
* Lead new-contract transitions and recompete readiness across the portfolio.
* Ensure company-wide compliance with FAR/DFARS, quality, security and audit requirements; drive strong CPARS ratings.
* Report portfolio health and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, Engineering, IT or a related field.
* 12+ years of professional experience, including 7+ years managing federal government contracts or programs.
* Demonstrated success leading multiple concurrent programs or a portfolio with combined value of $25M+ and 50+ staff.
* Experience with P&L management, financial forecasting and contract-level cost controls.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* U.S. citizenship and ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance.
* Executive-level communication skills, including briefing senior government and corporate leaders.

**Preferred Qualifications and Core Competencies**

* Master's degree (MBA, MPM or related).
* Active security clearance (Secret or higher).
* PgMP, FAC-P/PM Senior/Expert, Agile/SAFe or Lean Six Sigma certification.
* Experience building or maturing a PMO in a growing government contractor.
* Capture and proposal experience, including serving as proposed Key Personnel.
* Core competencies: strategic leadership, business acumen, talent development, customer relationships, risk management and accountability.

FedSync is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or veteran status.

**About Tessera Labs**

Tessera is an AI-native platform for enterprise transformation. The multi-agent platform delivers governed execution across ERP, CRM, HCM, and finance systems, cutting timelines from years to weeks and costs by more than half. Built on deep expertise across Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, Workday, and other systems of record, Tessera address the scope a system integrator would have traditionally taken up with the speed of execution and efficiency of an AI-native platform.

For decades, enterprises have struggled with fragmented business systems, where migrations have consumed hundreds of millions of dollars, data stayed inconsistent and unreliable, and business processes slowed under manual review. Tessera was founded to change that, for SAP and every other system enterprises depend on. The name itself — a tessera, a single tile in a mosaic — reflects our mission: unifying the disparate pieces of the enterprise into a coherent whole. Tessera is an AI-powered, multi-agent platform that harmonizes systems and lets teams work in plain English.

Our mission: Modernize global enterprises safely, automatically, and at unprecedented speed. We move fast, own outcomes end-to-end, and build at the frontier of applied AI for large-scale transformation.

**Role Summary**

jobs.description:
**Reports To:** Chief of Staff, CPO’s Office  
**Location**: USA (Remote)

**About us**  
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.

Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

**Our people**  
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

**Our impact**  
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.

Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

  

**About the role**

We’re hiring a Program Manager to help turn HighLevel’s People priorities into clear plans, coordinated programs, and strong execution.

Reporting to the Chief of Staff in the CPO’s Office, this role will serve as a senior individual contributor responsible for supporting People planning, leading cross functional special projects, and creating structure around work that spans multiple teams or does not have a natural functional owner.

The scope is intentionally broad as it will evolve with business priorities. You may support a workforce planning cycle one quarter, lead a cross-functional policy project the next, and then help implement a new People program or operating process. The common thread is your ability to take an approved priority, create clarity, align stakeholders, clarify decisions and ownership, and drive the work through completion.

You’ll partner closely with the Chief of Staff and work with teams across various functions in the organization. The ideal candidate is highly organized, calm under pressure, an excellent listener, and a strong problem solver who can quickly understand unfamiliar topics and turn ambiguity into an executable plan.

  

**What you’ll do**

**People Planning & Operating Rhythm**

* Support annual and quarterly People planning cycles, including priorities, timelines, dependencies, milestones, and follow-through.
* Leverage AI to build and maintain planning tools, trackers, decision logs, and operating mechanisms that give People leaders visibility into progress and risk.
* Coordinate cross-functional inputs for workforce planning, budgeting, organizational planning, and other recurring People processes.
* Prepare clear updates, recommendations, and materials for People leadership and executive discussions.
* Drive follow-through on decisions, actions, and commitments across People workstreams.
* Continuously improve how the People organization plans, tracks, and executes its priorities.

**Cross-Functional Special Projects**

* Lead cross-functional initiatives from initial scoping through implementation, particularly where ownership is unclear, multiple functions are involved, or dedicated project leadership is needed.
* Take loosely defined priorities and turn them into clear workstreams, owners, timelines, dependencies, and decision points.
* Coordinate stakeholders across People and partner functions to keep complex work moving.
* Conduct research, gather stakeholder input, synthesize findings, and develop recommendations to support decisions.
* Surface risks, tradeoffs, resource constraints, and decisions to the Chief of Staff and appropriate leaders.
* Support projects involving topics such as People policy, new program design, operating model changes, compliance readiness, employee programs, or other emerging business needs.
* Partner with the appropriate functional owners and subject matter experts so that specialized work remains with the teams accountable for it.
* Adapt quickly when priorities change, including pausing, redirecting, or closing work cleanly when leadership changes course.

**Program Management & Execution**

* Lead assigned people programs from planning through implementation.
* Establish clear ownership, governance, milestones, and escalation paths.
* Maintain visibility into progress, dependencies, risks, and decisions.

Our commitments are underpinned by the belief that safety, collaboration and well-being are integral to success. Headquartered in Chantilly, Virginia, we have approximately 50,000 employees in more than 70 countries across all 7 continents.

The **Senior Cybersecurity Risk Analyst** is a US remote, senior individual contributor position within the Cybersecurity Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GR&C) team. This role owns the enterprise's cyber risk assessment work: evaluating activities and operational decisions across the enterprise and articulating the resulting cyber risk to business leadership against the enterprise's risk appetite.

The work is assessment heavy. The Senior Cybersecurity Risk Analyst examines technology and operational decisions for cyber risk that compliance-driven review alone does not surface, then frames that risk in business terms so GR&C and leaders can make informed accept, mitigate, or remediate decisions. The role is a twin to the Compliance function: where Compliance concentrates on the administrative work of demonstrating conformance to mandatory controls, this role works alongside it to drive cohesive cyber risk management across the enterprise regardless of which framework imposes a given requirement.

Consistent with the GR&C charter, the role helps protect Amentum against internal and external cyber threats and helps set, improve, and make recommendations on the enterprise security program based on industry best practices, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines. GR&C surfaces and advises on risk so that business and operational owners can make informed decisions. This person must be technical enough to recognize risk in networking, cloud, endpoint, and identity decisions made by engineering and IT, and credible enough that their risk judgments carry weight with those teams and with leadership. The role acts on behalf of the entire enterprise rather than any single team, contract, or project, and brings attention to risk without hindering the business. **This position is US remote telework and requires US Citizenship.**

* Work with the Compliance function to ensure that mandatory control interpretations do not leave other cyber risk unaddressed, and that risk treatment is coherent across frameworks.
* Evaluate the cyber risk implications of technology decisions, recognizing risk in networking, cloud, endpoint, and identity and access architectures that compliance-only review would not surface.

jobs.title: Market Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
**Position Title:** Market Intelligence Analyst

**Location:** 633 3 rd Ave, New York, NY 10017

**Reports to:** Director of Strategic Intelligence and Pipeline

**Compensation** : $78,000 - $88,000/Yr ( *based on experience and qualifications* )

**About The Fedcap Group**
--------------------------

For more than 90 years, Fedcap has been turning possibility into reality. As a global nonprofit serving more than 335,000 people each year across the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and Australia, we open doors to economic mobility through innovative, evidence-based solutions in education, workforce development, health, and economic development. Join us and experience The Power of Possible, where your work creates real opportunities for people facing barriers to economic well-being and helps build stronger communities every day.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

Reporting to the Director of Strategic Intelligence and Pipeline, the Market Intelligence Analyst is responsible for generating high-quality leads and producing the external market insight required to build tomorrow's pipeline.

The postholder will proactively identify and assess potential opportunities through commissioner and funder intelligence, policy and procurement scanning, competitor analysis and market sizing. The role will turn external signals into clear lead briefs and actionable intelligence for Growth, Opportunity Management and senior decision-makers.

**Key Responsibilities**

##### **Lead Generation & Early Opportunity Identification**

Generate a continuous flow of credible, evidence-based leads across priority sectors, services and geographies. Identify opportunities early enough to support market shaping, relationship development and organizational readiness.

* Proactively scan target markets for new contracts, funding streams, grants, frameworks and adjacent growth opportunities.
* Monitor procurement portals, prior information notices, funding announcements, market engagement activity and published commissioning plans.
* Create and maintain a forward-looking opportunity radar, including expected value, timing, buyer, route to market and source evidence.
* Prepare initial lead briefs and assess strategic relevance, accessibility, maturity and next actions.
* Route viable leads to the Director and relevant Growth leaders for screening, ownership and progression into the enterprise pipeline.
* Track the conversion of intelligence-generated leads into qualified opportunities and use outcomes to improve lead-generation activity.

##### **Commissioner & Funder Intelligence**

Build a current, practical understanding of commissioners, funders and procurement bodies to strengthen lead generation and market positioning. Translate published priorities, budgets and commissioning intentions into clear implications for growth.

* Research commissioner and funder strategies, priorities, budgets and future commissioning intentions.
* Develop and maintain profiles of priority commissioners, funders and procurement authorities.
* Track consultations, market engagement events, pipeline publications and recommissioning cycles.
* Provide targeted intelligence to support Executive Directors with market-shaping and relationship activity.

##### **Policy, Funding & Procurement Scanning**

Monitor external developments that may create, accelerate or constrain future opportunities. Provide concise alerts and analysis so the organization can respond to policy change, new funding and procurement reform.

* Monitor relevant policy, legislative, regulatory, economic and funding developments across priority jurisdictions.
* Assess the likely impact of external changes on demand, commissioning models and market accessibility.
* Maintain procurement and funding calendars for priority markets and service areas.
* Issue timely alerts on material developments, approaching deadlines and emerging opportunities.
* Maintain source records and evidence trails for material intelligence.

##### **Market Assessment & Sizing**

Produce evidence-based assessments of market size, attractiveness and accessibility. Support decisions on where to invest, enter, monitor or deprioritize by combining external evidence with clear analysis.

* Conduct market sizing using available public, commercial and internal sources.
* Assess growth drivers, customer demand, funding outlook, barriers to entry and route-to-market considerations.
* Support market-entry, geography and service-line assessments.
* Compare opportunities and markets using agreed attractiveness and strategic-fit criteria.
* Present findings in concise market maps, briefing papers and recommendation summaries.

##### **Competitor & Ecosystem Intelligence**

Maintain a fact-based view of competitors, incumbents, partners and market movements. Identify threats, gaps and partnership possibilities that strengthen opportunity strategy and competitive positioning.

* Research competitor portfolios, contract awards, partnerships, acquisitions and observable strategic activity.
* Develop and maintain competitor and incumbent profiles for priority markets.
* Monitor new entrants, market disruptors and relevant partner ecosystems.
* Identify market gaps, likely competitive pressure and potential areas of differentiation.
* Provide early competitor intelligence to Growth, Opportunity Management and the Bid & Proposal Centre of Excellence.

##### **Intelligence Products & Knowledge Management**

Convert research into accessible, decision-ready products and maintain a reliable intelligence knowledge base. Ensure outputs are current, traceable and focused on actions and implications.

* Produce regular intelligence bulletins, opportunity alerts, market briefs and executive summaries.
* Maintain organized repositories for markets, commissioners, funders, procurements and competitors.
* Apply agreed research, sourcing, confidentiality and quality standards.
* Respond to priority research requests

jobs.description:
Hi, we're Oscar. We're hiring a Technical Program Manager, Data to join our Technical PMO team.

Oscar is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving our members. We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves—one that behaves like a doctor in the family.

  

**About the role:**

Lead the data transformation at the core of realizing better healthcare for millions of people.

Oscar is hiring a Technical Program Manager to join our Tech PMO, dedicated to a major enterprise data transformation. You'll partner closely with Data leadership to lead migration from planning through delivery, protecting the quality and integrity of the data our teams rely on every day.

We're looking for someone who has experience partnering with Data teams and leading a major enterprise data migration and who brings curiosity, initiative, and sound judgment. You can engage deeply with business partners, data scientists, data engineers, make complex dependencies and tradeoffs clear, and help leaders make timely decisions. You take ownership of execution while building trust with the people who produce and use the data.  
Your program will include revamping our data transformation and semantic layers, as well as evolving our data governance and data quality capabilities across the entire business. You'll coordinate Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Scientists, Analysts, and business owners through migration, validation, adoption, and operational handoff.

You'll have the opportunity to shape how Oscar delivers enterprise data programs and help build a strong TPM team. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Director of the Tech PMO, partnering closely with Data leadership. You'll lead technical program execution, with Data Engineering accountable for architecture and implementation.

You will report into the Director, Technical Program Management.

**Work Location:** This position is based in our New York City office, requiring a hybrid work schedule with 3 days of in-office work per week. Thursdays are a required in-office day for team meetings and events, while your other two office days are flexible to suit your schedule. #LI-Hybrid

**Pay Transparency:** The base pay for this role is: $117,576 - $154,319 per year. You are also eligible for employee benefits, participation in Oscar's unlimited vacation program, and annual performance bonuses.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Own the integrated enterprise data migration plan from scoping through delivery and operational handoff, with clear owners, migration waves, milestones, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.
* Turn ambiguity into action across dbt migration, Cube implementation, data governance, and data quality workstreams. Bring the right owners together and resolve gaps in scope, sequencing, and readiness.
* Partner with Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Scientists, Analysts, and business owners to map upstream and downstream dependencies, coordinate commitments, and make scope, sequencing, and capacity tradeoffs explicit.
* Anticipate migration risks and drive timely decisions. Escalate with clear options, recommendations, and impact on data quality, integrity, reporting, and business continuity.
* Coordinate data reconciliation, testing, cutover and rollback plans, adoption, and operational readiness. Ensure technical and business owners agree on validation evidence, go/no-go criteria, and required security, privacy, and compliance reviews.
* Support program planning and give Data and executive leaders a clear view of migration progress, readiness, unresolved decisions, and outcomes. Drive business acceptance and clear operational ownership for migrated domains.
* Help build a strong TPM team: share useful practices, challenge unnecessary processes, support colleagues, and turn lessons from delivery into improvements.
* Compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Requirements:**

* 5+ years of technical program or project management/process-oriented operations work experience.
* 2+ years of experience using coding languages such as SQL to analyze project performance and risks and develop erports for management and business owners.
* Experience independently leading complex software development programs across multiple teams, from planning through launch and operational handoff.
* Technical fluency in data pipelines, transformation layers, data models, semantic layers, lineage, and integrations, with the judgment to challenge migration plans, validation approaches, and implementation tradeoffs.
* Demonstrated ability to structure ambiguous enterprise programs, manage cross-domain dependencies and competing priorities, and coordinate data validation, cutover readiness, and business continuity.
* A record of building trust and influencing decisions across Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Scientists, Analysts, and business owners, and executive stakeholders without direct authority.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to translate technical migration risks into business impact and recommend a course of action to senior leaders.
* Strong ownership and follow-through, with examples of moving work forward when plans change or obstacles arise.

**Bonus points:**

* Experience in healthcare, health insurance, or another regulated industry.
* Experience with dbt and Cube, or comparable transformation and semantic-layer technologies.
* Experience implementing data governance, data quality controls, lineage, or consistent business metric definitions across domains.
* Experience coordinating external vendors and helping business and analytics teams adopt new data platforms and ways of working.
* Experience migrating business-critical analytics or reporting with staged validation, reconciliation, cutover, and rollback practice

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Implementation is a critical moment in the customer journey: it's where clients first see VTS deliver the value they bought, and where retention truly begins. In the Senior Implementation Manager role, you will guide global leaders in commercial real estate toward driving early, measurable value from VTS. You'll own onboarding for our largest, most sophisticated clients, leading enterprise rollouts of VTS AI, from portfolio-scale document abstraction to persona-based activation. Effective Senior Implementation Managers set our clients up for immediate value and long-term retention from day one. This role is fully client facing and is equal parts onboarding and outcome realization.

***\*\*Please note that this opportunity is located in New York, NY, and requires this hire to work from our office four days a week.\*\****

#### **What you can expect as a Senior Implementation Manager:**

This isn't your typical implementation role. At VTS, you'll join a lean, high-impact, AI-augmented implementation team that shares one mission with Client Success - deliver value to your client.

You will:

* **Command the Onboarding:** Own end-to-end onboarding for enterprise accounts, including scope, data readiness, configuration, enablement, and handoff, and run it with enough rigor that status, risk, and next steps are never in question.
* **Build Trusted Partnerships Early:** Establish trusted-advisor relationships with executive sponsors, asset managers, lease administrators, and senior decision-makers from kickoff, aligning every rollout to the business outcomes the client bought VTS to achieve.
* **Drive Time-to-Adoption, Not Just Go-Live:** VTS delivers value as soon as the data starts to flow into the platform. Move far beyond the deployment checklist. Onboarding and Outcomes continue to live side by side. Lead prescriptive, persona-based rollouts, run our adoption playbooks from the day of enablement, and use adoption signals, not task completion, to decide when an account is ready to transition to Client Success.
* **Lead Change:** Act as a change leader inside client organizations, proactively identifying workflow gaps and challenging clients when necessary so that VTS becomes how their teams actually work.
* **Orchestrate Delivery Partners:** Manage strategic relationships with third-party delivery partners, including our document abstraction partners. Hold them accountable to volume, quality, and timelines, and turn daily delivery data into clear priorities and escalations.
* **Mitigate Implementation Risk:** Use adoption data, delivery metrics, and modern tooling to spot at-risk rollouts early (delayed client data, low engagement, misaligned stakeholders) and deploy swift, cross-functional solutions before that risk reaches the renewal.
* **Collaborate Within a Coordinated Ecosystem:** Orchestrate Sales, Client Success, Support, Product, and Engineering through the implementation stage of the customer journey so clients experience one unified VTS team, ending in a clean, evidence-based handoff to their CSM.
* **Be the Voice of the Customer:** Channel product feedback, defects, and strategic client needs to Product and Engineering with the specificity needed to help shape the future of the VTS platform.
* **Be a Problem Solver:** Raise the Bar for the Team: Help shape how VTS onboards enterprise clients by contributing to our playbooks, runbooks, and processes, and mentor fellow IMs as we scale new product rollouts. Be hands on with leveraging technology to solve your problems.

#### **What Makes You a Great Fit?**

You're not looking to manage a project plan; you're looking to own an outcome. You are a structured communicator and a natural operator who pushes updates up rather than waiting to be asked, gets energized by ambiguity, and does your best work in high-stakes rooms. You could be a great fit if:

* You bring 4+ years of experience leading client-facing implementations, onboarding, or professional services engagements for enterprise SaaS clients.
* You have enterprise-grade presence: you're comfortable steering conversations with C-suite and senior stakeholders and don't hesitate in front of a full room.
* You communicate with structure and precision, in writing and live, so stakeholders always know where things stand, what's at risk, and what you recommend.
* You're deeply curious, coachable, and tech-savvy, and ready to embrace new AI tools and systems to work smarter, faster, and more analytically.
* You raise risk early and proactively, and you arrive with a recommendation rather than just a problem.
* Operational rigor is second nature: project plans, status hygiene, and on-track/off-track reporting are standard practice for you, not a stretch.
* You're data-driven and comfortable using adoption metrics and dashboards to make the case for action.
* It' s a plus if you:
* + You've managed vendors or outsourced delivery teams.
  + You bring fluency in Commercial Real Estate, lease administration or abstraction, or property management systems such as Yardi or MRI

The Procurement Intelligence Analyst develops and delivers the analytics, market intelligence, performance reporting, and data insights that enable Enterprise Procurement to make informed, data-driven decisions. The role transforms procurement, supplier, financial, and operational data into actionable insights supporting category strategy, sourcing, Vendor Management, value realization, risk governance, and executive decision-making. Working collaboratively with Category Management, Vendor Management, Procurement Operations Hub, Finance, the Procurement Center of Excellence (COE), and business stakeholders, the role establishes trusted procurement reporting, spend visibility, supplier and vendor performance analytics, savings measurement, and market intelligence. The Procurement Intelligence Analyst also partners with the Procurement Digital Transformation Lead to advance automated reporting, AI-enabled analytics, and predictive insights as the organization builds a more digitally enabled procurement operating model.

* Partner with Category Management to provide fact-based analytical support for category planning, supplier landscape assessments, business cases, and commercial recommendations.

**Supplier & Vendor Performance Intelligence**

* Develop and maintain supplier and vendor performance reporting, scorecards, and analytical views in support of Vendor Management and Category Management.
* Aggregate and analyze SLA, KPI, risk, issue, financial, and operational performance data to identify performance trends, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities.

jobs.title: Pipeline Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
**Position Title:** Pipeline Intelligence Analyst

**Location:** 633 3 rd Ave, New York, NY 10017

**Reports to:** Director of Strategic Intelligence and Pipeline

**Compensation** : $82,000 - $92,000/Yr ( *based on experience and qualifications* )

**About The Fedcap Group**

For more than 90 years, Fedcap has been turning possibility into reality. As a global nonprofit serving more than 335,000 people each year across the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and Australia, we open doors to economic mobility through innovative, evidence-based solutions in education, workforce development, health, and economic development. Join us and experience The Power of Possible, where your work creates real opportunities for people facing barriers to economic well-being and helps build stronger communities every day.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

Reporting to the Director of Strategic Intelligence and Pipeline, the Pipeline Intelligence Analyst is responsible for maintaining a trusted enterprise pipeline and producing the analysis required to manage growth performance, opportunity priorities and portfolio risk.

The postholder will drive CRM discipline, data quality, reporting and dashboarding, while providing insight on conversion, must-win priorities, recompete exposure, concentration and pipeline risk. The role will turn pipeline data into clear management information that supports governance, financial alignment and action.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Pipeline Data Quality & CRM Discipline**
------------------------------------------

Maintain a complete, accurate and trusted enterprise pipeline by applying agreed data, stage and governance standards. Work directly with opportunity owners to resolve gaps and ensure records reflect the current position.

* Monitor Salesforce and associated pipeline records for completeness, accuracy, currency and consistency.
* Validate opportunity value, stage, timing, probability, ownership, next steps and supporting evidence.
* Follow up missing or overdue updates with opportunity owners and track resolution of data-quality issues.
* Apply agreed pipeline definitions, entry and exit criteria and mandatory data standards.
* Produce data-quality reports and identify recurring control or adoption issues.

**Pipeline Reporting & Dashboards**
-----------------------------------

Produce clear, reliable management information that gives leaders visibility of pipeline value, maturity, movement and risk. Maintain dashboards and reporting packs that support action and decision-making.

* Prepare regular pipeline dashboards, KPI reports, review packs and executive summaries.
* Report pipeline value by stage, geography, service line, customer, owner and expected decision date.
* Highlight material movements, stalled opportunities, overdue actions and changes in assumptions.
* Maintain consistent reporting logic, definitions and reconciliations across reports.
* Improve reporting efficiency through appropriate dashboarding, automation and standard templates.

**Pipeline Reviews & Governance Support**
-----------------------------------------

Coordinate the information and analysis required for effective pipeline governance. Ensure review forums have accurate records, clear actions and timely follow-through.

* Prepare agendas, analysis and opportunity information for pipeline and portfolio reviews.
* Identify records that do not meet qualification, evidence or stage-gate requirements.
* Capture decisions, actions, owners and deadlines arising from governance reviews.
* Monitor agreed actions and escalate unresolved data or process issues to the Director.
* Maintain the governance calendar and supporting documentation.

**Prioritization & Portfolio Analysis**
---------------------------------------

Provide analysis that supports evidence-based opportunity prioritization and must-win management. Help leaders understand pipeline balance, resource implications and alignment with growth strategy.

* Maintain prioritization scores, must-win reporting and portfolio views using agreed criteria.
* Analyze pipeline balance across sectors, commissioners, territories, service lines and maturity stages.
* Identify concentration, diversification and coverage trends within the opportunity portfolio.
* Prepare analytical inputs for resource allocation and investment discussions.
* Track whether priority opportunities continue to meet the evidence required for their status.

**Conversion, Win/Loss & Performance Insight**
----------------------------------------------

Track how opportunities progress through the lifecycle and identify where conversion is improving or weakening. Convert performance data into practical insight for governance and continuous improvement.

* Calculate and monitor stage conversion, win rates, pipeline velocity and ageing using agreed definitions.
* Analyze bottlenecks, stalled opportunities and patterns in progression or attrition.
* Support win/loss reviews by preparing data, trends and opportunity histories.
* Compare performance across relevant portfolio dimensions without overstating conclusions.
* Produce concise recommendations and follow-up measures arising from analysis.

**Recompete, Concentration & Pipeline Risk Insight**
----------------------------------------------------

Maintain visibility of contract expiry, recompete exposure, concentration and other risks that may affect future growth. Provide early warning of coverage gaps and changes that require management action.

* Maintain the recompete and contract-expiry view and reconcile it with the active pipeline.
* Monitor pipeline maturity, probability, timing, dependencies and key risk indicators.
* Analyze exposure by commissioner, funder, contract, market, geography and service line.
* Identify future revenue gaps, weak pipeline coverage and material changes in portfolio risk.
* Support scenario and mitigation analysis with Finance, Growth and Opportunity Management.

Experience leading cyber security or technical programs.

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

* MA/MS or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Security, or a related field

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Founded in 1989 and headquartered in Reston, Virginia, SOSi is a private defense and government solutions business specializing in advanced technology systems and mission support. Its capabilities include data science, software development, network engineering, intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR), and logistics.

 **Job Description**

SOSi is seeking a Program Manager (Intelligence). The Program Manager leads a nationwide intelligence research and analysis program supporting federal law enforcement and national security operations. As the primary point of contact with government contracting officers, CORs, and senior mission leadership, the Program Manager is accountable for contract performance, workforce management, and mission outcomes. Based in the Washington, DC area, the Program Manager will lead a large, geographically distributed team of cleared intelligence analysts. Responsibilities will include staffing coordination, recruiting and retention, quality control, performance monitoring, and personnel transitions. The Program Manager will set consistent analytic and operational standards across headquarters and field locations, track performance metrics, resolve staffing and performance issues quickly, and deliver timely status and staffing reports. They will also lead the program through stand-up and steady-state operations, coordinating with corporate recruiting, security, and transition teams to keep the workforce fully staffed and mission-ready. This position is for an experienced leader who builds trusted relationships with government stakeholders, manages competing priorities in a fast-paced operational environment, and maintains high standards of accountability.

**Essential Job Duties**

* Conduct intelligence research and all-source analysis to support federal immigration enforcement and national security operations, integrating information from law enforcement, government, commercial, and open sources.
* Evaluate the reliability, relevance, and accuracy of source information, and identify information gaps, inconsistencies, and collection needs.
* Produce finished intelligence products, including assessments, bulletins, target packages, and briefing materials, that meet established analytic tradecraft, sourcing, and quality standards.
* Perform trend and threat analysis to identify emerging patterns, risks, and priorities affecting enforcement operations at the national, regional, and local levels.
* Conduct network and relationship analysis to identify associations among individuals, organizations, and activities, using link-analysis and visualization tools to present findings.
* Perform intelligence gap analysis and recommend collection priorities and research strategies to address unanswered intelligence requirements.
* Provide direct analytical support to field operations, including research on short timelines, support to operational planning, and responses to requests for information from field personnel.
* Prepare and deliver oral and written briefings to Government leadership, operational personnel, and partner agencies, tailoring content to the audience.
* Coordinate and share information with other federal, state, and local law enforcement and intelligence partners, following applicable information-sharing, privacy, and dissemination rules.
* Maintain accurate records of research, sources, and analytic conclusions, and contribute to recurring status, production, and workload reporting.
* Handle classified, law enforcement sensitive, and personally identifiable information under applicable security, privacy, and records-management requirements.
* Support quality-control processes by participating in peer review, incorporating feedback, and contributing to consistent analytic standards across a geographically distributed team.
* Work independently on complex, ambiguous analytic problems while adapting to shifting operational priorities.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Active TS security clearance with SCI eligibility.
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
  + A master's degree or additional experience may substitute for some required experience.
* Ten (10) or more years of experience in intelligence, law enforcement, or national security programs, including at least five (5) years managing contract programs.
* Demonstrated experience managing a geographically distributed workforce of 75 or more cleared personnel, including through subordinate regional or site leaders.
* Experience leading contract transitions or program stand-ups, including rapid recruiting, onboarding, and security processing.
* Experience managing performance metrics, quality control, staffing, and recurring reporting under firm-fixed-price or performance-based contracts.
* Demonstrated ability to serve as the primary contractor interface with government contracting officers, CORs, and senior mission leadership.
* Ability to work on-site in the Washington, DC area and travel to field locations as needed.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification.

* Experience with workforce retention in hard-to-staff locations.

**Work Environment**

* Normal office conditions.

jobs.description:
All Source Intelligence Analyst

**The Opportunity:**

With all the information available today, it takes a skilled intelligence analyst to know how to find and interpret the best data to give their clients the right answers. With the critical decisions made in our military every day, we need an intel analyst like you to do just that. As an All-Source Intelligence Analyst, you use your specialized technical intelligence, military or government experience and your attention to detail to develop intelligence products, including intelligence papers and briefings, to give your client the actionable intelligence and context they need. If you have strong analytical skills and a problem-solving mindset, we have an opportunity to use those skills to safeguard our warfighters and enable our military and national leaders to shape national security policy.

As an intelligence analyst on our team, you will help your client identify and understand foreign and asymmetric threats to U.S. Army plans, processes, and other activities as directed. You will have the opportunity to explore new data sources and combine information from disparate sources to develop tradecraft as you build assessments and briefings for the intelligence community and senior leaders and policymakers. You will help your team provide intelligence-informed, adversary-centric insights that may be separate and distinct from other established channels of military advice or finished intelligence products and analysis prepared for senior leaders. You will assist your team to challenge intelligence assumptions, sometimes providing alternative analysis from the perspective of adversaries to inform ASL decision making. As the authority on your portfolios, your client will look to you for time-critical recommendations, often under pressure.

This is a chance to grow your expertise, develop new skills in intelligence analysis, production, and briefing senior leaders, and share your methodologies with other analysts. We focus on growing as a team to deliver the best support to our customers, so you’ll have resources for mentoring and learning new skills and tools.

Work with us as we provide the right information at the right time to support the critical needs of our national and military leaders.

  

Join us. The world can’t wait.

**You Have:**

* Experience with full-spectrum Integrated Air and Missile Defense (IAMD) operations, to include concept-of-operations, rules of engagement, and planning
* Experience in the U.S. Intelligence Community (IC), Service Headquarters, or Combatant Command environments
* Experience with ICD 203-compliant intelligence analysis
* Experience collaborating with other members of the IC or DoW on information sharing, driving collection, and addressing analytic disputes
* Experience working on the Joint Worldwide Intelligence Communications System (JWICS) and proficiency with its tools and functions
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to develop high-quality deliverables tailored to senior policymakers or defense stakeholders, including complex written products and formal or informal briefings
* TS/SCI clearance
* Bachelor’s degree and 5+ years of experience as an All-Source Intelligence Analyst or Master’s degree and 3+ years of experience as an All-Source Intelligence Analyst

**Nice If You Have:**

* Experience in the U.S. military

**About this role**

Forward Deployed Business Analyst

**Your team**

The BlackRock Transformation Office (BTO) is a global group of change professionals that delivers strategic transformation to help make BlackRock greater than the sum of its parts. We drive 1BLK outcomes by continuously connecting and being students of the firm’s people, processes and technology.

We are a versatile team with varied experiences and backgrounds, motivated by the challenge of finding solutions that benefit BlackRock and our clients. In BTO, we focus on developing our people, strengthening leadership and delivery skills, and broadening firm and industry knowledge. Projects and roles consider both successful delivery and individual development objectives and career aspirations.

**Your role and impact**

The Forward Deployed Business Analyst will work in cross-functional teams to reimagine, innovate and scale solutions that drive growth and operating models within the firm.

This is not a traditional business analysis role centered on gathering requirements and handing them to technology. The role combines business analysis, product discovery, business architecture and hands-on prototyping to turn ambiguous problems into tangible solutions that business users and engineers can test and refine together.

Successful candidates will combine the structured thinking of a business analyst, the prioritization instincts of a product owner, the enterprise perspective of a business architect and the bias to action of a hands-on builder.

**Your responsibilities**

In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. * Partner continuously with business experts, product managers, engineers, architects, data specialists and control partners from discovery through implementation.
* **Develop measurable project objectives, drive consensus, and communicate plans, progress and outcomes effectively to stakeholders and management across levels.**

**Your experience**

* Experience in business architecture and operating-model design, connecting solutions to business capabilities, roles, governance, policy ownership, controls and exception handling.
* Proficiency in prototype-led problem solving and rapidly converting ambiguous business problems into functional prototypes that stakeholders can see, test and challenge.
* Expertise using AI-enabled development environments to accelerate analysis, prototyping, requirements definition and testing, including critically evaluating generated outputs, maintaining traceability and understanding where human judgment remains essential.
* Experience with iterative delivery and hands-on ownership through cycles of analysis, experimentation and solution shaping.

* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate objectives and influence outcomes.
  

  

**Our benefits**

**Our hybrid work model**

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**

  

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We combine smart technology with real human support to match our customers with the best deals – quickly and effortlessly. With trusted partnerships including Compare the Market, USwitch for Business, MoneySuperMarket and Confused.com, we're committed to help SMEs get the best deals for their business essentials every time.

**The role**

We're looking for detail-oriented and analytical **AI Operations Analysts** to play a critical role in supporting the governance and quality assurance of AI-driven processes across Bionic.

As part of our Business Excellence function, you'll sit at the intersection of Operations, Compliance and AI Innovation. You'll be responsible for reviewing AI-generated outcomes, validating results against available evidence and ensuring decisions are applied fairly, consistently and accurately before they are used in downstream sales and operational processes.

This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience working with AI technologies while helping shape how AI is used responsibly in a fast-growing business. If you're naturally curious, highly organised and enjoy solving problems through evidence-based decision making, we'd love to hear from you.

**Key responsibilities**

AI Validation & Quality Assurance

* Validate AI-generated outcomes across Energy and Insurance before they are used in business processes.
* Review call recordings, transcripts and AI rationale to determine whether outcomes are accurate and appropriately applied.
* Identify true fails, false fails, accepted exceptions and potential technical issues.
* Ensure validation activities are completed accurately and consistently against agreed criteria.

Analysis & Reporting

* Update system records and validation fields to ensure reporting remains accurate and reliable.
* Support monthly reporting cycles through completion of validation reviews and challenge processes.
* Conduct periodic sampling activities to identify potential false-pass trends and support ongoing assurance.
* Maintain clear audit trails and documentation for validation decisions and escalations.

Continuous Improvement

* Track recurring validation themes, process gaps and AI tool limitations.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes, controls and reporting accuracy.
* Escalate technical issues and recurring system challenges to relevant stakeholders.
* Contribute insights that support the ongoing evolution of AI-supported workflows and governance.

Stakeholder Collaboration

* Work closely with Business Excellence, AI Innovation, Sales Leadership and Legal & Compliance teams.
* Support the fair, transparent and evidence-led use of AI outputs across the organisation.
* Build strong working relationships across technical and operational teams to drive positive outcomes.

**About you**

We're looking for people who combine strong analytical thinking with exceptional attention to detail. You'll be comfortable working with data, applying defined criteria consistently and making objective decisions based on evidence.

You'll likely have:

* Excellent attention to detail and a highly accurate approach to work.
* Strong judgement and the ability to make fair, evidence-based decisions.
* The ability to identify patterns, trends, process issues and root causes.
* Strong written communication skills and the ability to clearly document decisions.
* Confidence in escalating complex, unclear or high-risk issues when required.
* Experience working with multiple stakeholders across operational, compliance or technical teams.
* The ability to manage competing priorities while meeting important deadlines.
* A professional and confidential approach when handling sensitive information.

Required skills & experience

* Strong IT literacy with experience using business systems and learning new technologies quickly.
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Outlook and Teams.
* Experience working with structured data and reporting outputs.
* Ability to identify and document technical issues, data gaps and process failures.

Desirable Skills & Experience

* Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM platforms.
* Experience using Tableau or other reporting and analytics tools.
* Experience reviewing customer interactions, call recordings or transcripts.
* Exposure to AI tools, speech analytics, quality monitoring or automated evaluation systems.
* Experience within compliance, quality assurance, audit, sales support or operational controls environments.

**Job Description**

Key Responsibilities

Privacy Program Management & Reporting

* Structure and maintain privacy operations work in Azure DevOps (ADO), Jira, or similar work-management tools, including custom work item types and fields mapped to privacy concepts (jurisdiction, data type, risk tier).

* Build and maintain KPI dashboards and reporting (e.g., DSAR SLA compliance, assessment backlog age, incident response times) for privacy program leadership, using ADO Analytics, Power BI, or similar tools.

* Track cross-functional privacy work items that depend on Legal, Security, and Product teams, and proactively surface bottlenecks and at-risk items.

* Coordinate responses to data subject access requests (DSARs) and other data subject rights requests, ensuring timely resolution within statutory timelines across jurisdictions.

Track and report on privacy program metrics and KPIs for leadership and relevant stakeholders.  



Privacy Risk Assessments

* Conduct and document privacy impact assessments (PIAs), data protection impact assessments (DPIAs), and transfer impact assessments (TIAs) for new products, features, and vendor engagements.

* Support automated assessment workflows that trigger and assign PIAs/DPIAs based on risk-based conditional logic (data type, processing purpose, jurisdiction, vendor risk tier), escalating high-risk triggers for senior review.

Data Mapping & ROPA Maintenance
