jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
**Hi, We're Centerfield!**

Supercharged customer acquisition. Centerfield delivers outcome-based digital marketing solutions and personalized omnichannel experiences for the world’s leading brands. Powered by our proprietary Dugout platform, Centerfield acquires customers at scale for leading residential service, insurance, e-commerce, and B2B brands. Centerfield’s digital experiences and digital brands, such as **Business.com** and **BroadbandNow.com**, reach more than 150 million in-market shoppers annually. Centerfield is headquartered in Silicon Beach and is proud to be recognized by Built in LA as a Best Place to Work in Los Angeles.

**Role Overview**
=================

The Business Analyst joins Centerfield’s Business Analytics team to translate data into actionable insights that guide business strategy and improve operational efficiency. In this mid-senior role, the Business Analyst partners with cross-functional teams to understand business needs, deliver tailored analytics solutions, and support decision-making. The role combines strong business acumen, technical proficiency, and clear communication to connect analytical findings to meaningful business outcomes.

**Core Responsibilities**
=========================

* Translate complex datasets into meaningful insights using dashboards, AI-assisted data storytelling, and SQL, with a focus on business implications.
* Build and maintain intuitive dashboards and reports in Looker that tell a clear story and guide stakeholders toward strategic actions.
* Conduct regular and ad hoc reporting to identify trends, performance drivers, and growth opportunities.
* Partner with stakeholders across Marketing, Sales, and Operations to understand their goals and challenges and deliver tailored analytics solutions.
* Act as a thought partner to Operations, using data to support process improvements and efficiency optimizations.
* Own recurring reporting for assigned business areas and manage multiple projects independently.
* Stay current on industry trends and emerging technologies in business analytics and operations.
* Consistently show up like a Centerfielder by embodying company values in everyday interactions, decision-making, and collaboration.
* Continuously evolve yourself, your team, or the business by embracing learning, innovation, and opportunities for improvement.

**Job Requirements**
====================

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Data Science, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in data analytics or business analysis, preferably in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
* Strong proficiency in SQL, with hands-on experience building dashboards in Looker.
* Proficiency in Excel for data analysis.
* Demonstrated ability to connect data to business outcomes, with strong business judgment.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence nontechnical stakeholders.
* A self-directed approach, with strong attention to detail, organization, and the ability to manage multiple initiatives.
* Preferred: experience with BigQuery, exposure to the insurance industry, and familiarity with its key business metrics and operational dynamics.

**Life at Centerfield...**

* Competitive salary
* Unlimited PTO – take a break when you need it!
* Industry leading medical, dental, and vision plans + generous parental leave
* 401(k) company match plan – fully vested day 1
* Award winning culture & unprecedented team spirit (featured in LA Business Journal & Built In LA)
* Paid charity and volunteer days (local mentor programs, adopt a pet, beach cleanup, etc.)
* Career growth – we enjoy promoting from within!

  #LI-TM1

**AI & Interview Policy**

At Centerfield, we use AI tools internally to support efficiency and fairness in our hiring process, including resume screening and administrative tasks.

Candidates are welcome to use AI tools ethically to prepare for interviews, such as practicing responses or researching questions. However, all responses during the interview process should reflect your own knowledge, experience, and judgment.

The use of AI tools to generate responses during live interviews, technical assessments, or written submissions is not permitted unless explicitly stated otherwise.  
  
**To learn more, visit us** **Here****.**

Interviews will take place after resumes have been screened for the minimum requirements. Please note that this position is not restricted solely to the responsibilities listed above and that the job scope and responsibilities are subject to change.

For more information about our collection, use, and disclosure of your personal information in connection with our evaluating your candidacy, please visit our Privacy Policy at https://www.centerfield.com/privacy-policy/.

*Centerfield Media is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under federal, state or local law.*

Compensation Range: $80K - $100K

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Lancée en 2021 avec l’ambition de devenir l’insurtech européenne de référence sur le risque cyber, Stoïk est soutenue par certains des investisseurs les plus renommés au monde et a co-construit son produit d’assurance avec des assureurs et des réassureurs de premier plan, tels que Tokio Marine HCC et Swiss Re.

Stoïk protège et assure aujourd’hui plus de 14 000 entreprises dans 7 pays européens, avec une équipe de plus de 180 collaborateurs. Notre modèle va au-delà de l’assurance cyber : nous associons la couverture à nos propres outils de sécurité, à une surveillance 24h/24 et à une équipe interne de réponse à incident qui traite plus de 150 incidents par mois. Notre mission : être le CISO de l’Europe.

**Le poste**
------------

Nous recherchons un ou une Data Analyst pour rejoindre notre équipe data. Le cœur du poste consiste à créer et à maintenir les graphiques, les chiffres et les rapports qui décrivent l’activité de l’entreprise.

* En tant que startup en forte croissance, Stoïk ajuste en permanence sa stratégie commerciale au rythme du lancement de nouveaux produits et de l’ouverture de nouveaux marchés. Les nouvelles fonctionnalités de notre logiciel ont besoin d’indicateurs pour être évaluées. L’analyse de données est donc nécessaire aussi bien pour mesurer le succès du plan en cours que pour préparer le suivant.
* Parce qu’elle commercialise des contrats d’assurance, l’entreprise doit suivre son portefeuille afin d’ajuster sa souscription. L’assurance est un produit atypique : le prix facturé est connu d’avance, mais pas le coût pour l’assureur. Un reporting détaillé est donc indispensable pour suivre d’un côté les primes, de l’autre les sinistres.
* Acteur de la cybersécurité, Stoïk collecte par ailleurs une grande quantité de données via ses scanners d’infrastructure et de vulnérabilités. Pour prévenir les incidents et réagir vite, ces données doivent être exploitées afin, par exemple, d’alerter les assurés concernés dès la publication d’une nouvelle faille critique.

**Principales missions**
------------------------

* Échanger avec les autres équipes, en particulier les équipes produit, opérations, finance et customer success, pour identifier les indicateurs qu’elles ont besoin de suivre. Cela suppose de comprendre nos processus produit, commerciaux et assurantiels.
* Écrire les transformations nécessaires au calcul de ces indicateurs à partir de nos données brutes. La fiabilité est primordiale. Ces calculs tournant régulièrement, les autres membres de l’équipe data vous aideront à traiter les enjeux d’optimisation.
* Choisir, pour chaque grandeur, les chiffres et les visualisations les plus adaptés. Une donnée n’est éclairante que si elle est présentée avec clarté, et un graphique compréhensible d’un seul coup d’œil fait toute la différence.
* Travailler sur les droits d’accès aux données, afin que chacun dispose des informations dont il a besoin tout en limitant l’exposition inutile aux données sensibles.
* Accompagner les utilisateurs avancés pour qu’ils construisent leurs propres tableaux de bord en s’appuyant sur le travail de l’équipe data.

**Profil recherché**
--------------------

Sur le plan technique, nous recherchons un ou une Data Analyst avec :

* Une solide maîtrise du SQL (indispensable). Une expérience de PostgreSQL en particulier est un plus, puisque c’est là que s’effectue l’essentiel de nos transformations de données.
* Une pratique de la construction de graphiques et de visualisations avec des outils comme Metabase, Tableau, Power BI ou équivalent. Au-delà de la maîtrise d’un logiciel précis, nous cherchons une bonne compréhension de la manière de présenter des chiffres.
* L’envie d’automatiser une partie de son propre travail à l’aide d’outils d’IA.
* Une expérience préalable des outils d’analytics produit web, comme PostHog, est un plus.

**Processus de recrutement**
----------------------------

* Un premier entretien de découverte
* Un test technique à réaliser chez vous
* Un second entretien pour échanger sur les résultats du test
* Un échange avec les fondateurs

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager III, Data Operations, Geo
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program management.
* Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, and the implementation of GenAI-driven moderation frameworks.
* Experience running technical programs and utilizing data analysis tools.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
* Experience working with external developers and APIs.

**About the job**
-----------------

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

As a Technical Program Manager for the GDO Developer team, you will serve as a technical and strategic leader driving the Geo’s multi-ecosystem priorities (e.g. Destinations) and Makers Data Quality programs. You will act as a critical bridge between product requirements and geospatial data execution. You will lead high-complexity pillars involving AI, telemetry, and spatial analysis to establish "self-healing" pipelines from developer logs and scale spatial remediation initiatives. You’ll maintain strong alignment with executive leads, Product Managers, and Engineering counterparts to deliver on team goals.

The Geo team is focused on building the most accurate, comprehensive, and useful maps for our users, through products like Maps, Earth, Street View, Google Maps Platform, and more. Every month, more than a billion people rely on Maps services to explore the world and navigate their daily lives.  
  
The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Collaborate with Geo Makers and Real World Model PMs to interpret product goal and convert overarching roadmaps into actionable, high-impact data initiatives.
* Partner with PM, Engineering and Data Science to implement coverage and quality improvement strategies and drive spatial remediation efforts globally.
* Steer technical experiments and analytics for data coverage and validation, utilizing agentic AI frameworks, Gemini-powered workflows, and machine learning models.
* Manage operational metrics, review evaluations, structure data acquisition business cases, and direct program pipelines efficiently.
* Prepare and deliver regular communications, presentations, and reports. Establish and maintain effective governance processes for Geo Data initiatives for developers.

Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

**What You'll Do:**
-------------------

You'll join CoreWeave's Global Security & Resilience organization to build and drive the security program supporting our rapidly expanding international footprint — including offices we operate directly and locations where we support our data center teams. You'll work closely with executive protection, the GSOC, External Affairs, and cross-functional business leaders to protect our people and operations as CoreWeave scales globally.

The Staff Security Program Manager, International Security will own and drive CoreWeave's international security program, with responsibility for global travel security, international office and site protection, global security partnerships and outreach, and support for executive protection and event security as needed. You'll partner closely with CoreWeave's Senior Manager, Corporate Security, who leads the domestic program, to coordinate standards, incident response, and shared protective operations.

This individual contributor role combines enterprise program ownership with hands-on operational execution. You'll design and stand up a world-class travel security program — pre-travel risk assessments, traveler tracking and duty-of-care protocols, in-country support, and emergency response for employees traveling or working abroad. You'll also establish security standards for CoreWeave's growing international office footprint and the locations where CoreWeave supports its data center teams, in partnership with Facilities, Data Center Operations, and local leadership.

A significant part of this role is external-facing: building and sustaining global partnerships with law enforcement, intelligence services, diplomatic security, industry peers, and trusted local security providers in the countries where CoreWeave operates. You'll also provide tactical, hands-on support for executive protection and event security as needed — including advances, logistics coordination, and on-the-ground protective coverage — both domestically and internationally.

Success in this role requires strategic thinking, cultural fluency, and sound judgment operating in ambiguous, fast-moving international environments. You must be comfortable building programs from the ground up, influencing stakeholders without direct authority, working through a network of internal teams, contractors, and in-country partners, and delivering results with limited on-the-ground infrastructure. This role has no direct reports.

**About the role:**
-------------------

* Design, build, and own CoreWeave's global travel security program, including pre-travel risk assessments, country risk ratings, traveler tracking, duty-of-care protocols, and coordination of 24/7 emergency response and evacuation support for employees traveling or working abroad.

* Coordinate with the GSOC, the domestic Corporate Security team, and internal response teams to ensure seamless monitoring, escalation, and incident management for international employees, offices, and events.
* Develop budget recommendations, manage approved international security program spend, and oversee the vendor and travel-security-provider portfolio and technology roadmap, including traveler tracking and mass-notification tools.
* Advise senior leaders and cross-functional partners in People, Legal, Real Estate, and Data Center Operations on international security risk and risk-informed business decisions.

jobs.description:
This position will work one day per week onsite in San Francisco.

The AI Program Manager serves as an organization-wide expert and strategic advisor leading UCSF’s enterprise AI program across clinical care, research, education, and administrative operations. The incumbent partners with Enterprise AI product, technical, and leadership stakeholders to translate institutional priorities and complex business needs into adoption plans, enablement programs, stakeholder engagement strategies, feedback loops, and sustainable operating practices. The role evaluates organizational readiness, workflows, stakeholder needs, and performance data to identify opportunities that improve institutional effectiveness, workforce experience, quality, and mission outcomes.

The incumbent coordinates the adoption, enablement, communications, stakeholder engagement, value tracking, and operational readiness components of a high-impact portfolio of AI initiatives from intake through implementation, adoption, value realization, and transition to operations. The role supports prioritization and resource planning by preparing analysis, maintaining visibility into progress and risks, facilitating multidisciplinary coordination, and escalating complex or politically sensitive issues for leadership decision-making.

The AI Program Manager leads awareness and adoption of approved AI tools by communicating available capabilities, appropriate use cases, limitations, support resources, and product roadmaps. Working with senior leaders and clinical, research, academic, operational, technology, and risk stakeholders, the incumbent advances responsible AI adoption, informs vendor and product decisions, leads organizational change, and represents UCSF in relevant University and industry forums. The role works in close partnership with Enterprise AI product leadership, who retain accountability for product strategy, platform roadmap, prioritization recommendations, and product/vendor decision-making.

  

**Department Overview**

UCSF Enterprise Information and Analytics (EIA) advances the institution’s data and analytics capabilities in support of patient care, research, education, and administrative operations. EIA develops and maintains enterprise platforms and services that integrate data from across UCSF, promote consistent and trustworthy information, and support informed decision-making. Its portfolio includes enterprise data warehousing and data lakes, data integration, business intelligence, reporting and analytics, data governance, and data catalog services. EIA also establishes the policies, standards, and processes that enable institutional data to be accessed and used responsibly.

Enterprise AI builds on this foundation by delivering secure, scalable, and responsible artificial intelligence capabilities to the UCSF community. The program integrates AI strategy, governance, platforms, portfolio management, adoption, training, communications, and stakeholder engagement. It supports enterprise services such as UCSF ChatGPT Enterprise and the Versa API, providing secure access to generative AI and multiple AI models. In partnership with technology, privacy, security, legal, compliance, clinical, academic, and operational stakeholders, Enterprise AI identifies and prioritizes high-value opportunities, communicates available capabilities and roadmaps, accelerates responsible adoption, and measures institutional value.

* Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience in organizational consulting, strategic planning, or organizational change, including leading complex cross-functional initiatives.

* Knowledge of generative AI capabilities, limitations, and adoption patterns, including associated privacy, security, safety, ethical, accessibility, and responsible-use considerations.
* Demonstrated ability to design and operate portfolio intake, evaluation, prioritization, governance, business-case, and value-realization processes.
* Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to evaluate complex organizational needs, workflows, risks, dependencies, resource requirements, and expected benefits.
* Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and influence senior leaders and technical, clinical, research, academic, administrative, operational, and governance stakeholders without direct authority.

* Strong technical fluency across enterprise applications, systems integration, data and analytics platforms, information security, cloud services, or enterprise architecture, with the ability to translate between technical teams and organizational stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to establish performance measures and use quantitative and qualitative data to evaluate adoption, user experience, risk, program health, and institutional value.
* Ability to exercise independent judgment, establish priorities, and resolve highly complex or politically sensitive issues involving ambiguity, competing interests, and multiple constituencies.

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Onos Health**

Onos Health’s mission is simple but ambitious: ensure every healthcare dollar goes toward delivering the highest quality care. Today, nearly 30% of U.S. healthcare spending is wasted due to ineffective care and administrative burden caused by misalignment between providers and payers.

Onos is addressing this by building the AI platform that enables health plans to understand clinical care at scale. By transforming unstructured clinical documentation into actionable insights, we help payers make faster, more informed decisions, identify opportunities to improve quality and reduce waste, and ensure more healthcare dollars are directed toward delivering better outcomes.

Come join a category-defining company and transform how healthcare is managed in the U.S.

**Why Onos?**

Meaningful impact: Help solve one of healthcare’s biggest challenges by improving quality while reducing waste.

Ownership: Take on significant responsibility from day one and shape a rapidly growing company.

Direct collaboration: Work alongside experienced founders with deep expertise in healthcare, AI, and product development.

High-performing team: Join a transparent, collaborative, and execution-focused culture.

Build something new: Help define the next generation of AI-powered healthcare analytics.

**The Role**

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to turn health plan data into the reporting, analyses, and insights our customers rely on.

You’ll work hands-on with claims, authorization, eligibility, and clinical review data from our health plan customers. You’ll build and maintain the analyses and dashboards that show customers what’s happening in their populations: utilization trends, provider variation, cost, and the impact of programs running on the Onos platform.

This role works closely with our data science, product, and customer teams. This role is tightly focused on core analytics – tackling complex analytical questions independently. You’ll own analyses end to end, from digging into data to presenting results to customer stakeholders, and you’ll help make repeatable analyses into standard reporting in the product.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

**Customer Analytics & Reporting**

* Build and maintain customer-facing reports and dashboards covering utilization, cost, provider performance, and program outcomes.
* Run analyses that answer specific customer questions, such as where spend is concentrated, which providers are outliers, and how a program is affecting utilization.
* Support ROI and impact analyses by preparing data, running calculations, and checking results against agreed methodologies.
* Prepare findings for customer meetings and present results to analytics and operational teams at health plans.

**Data Onboarding & Quality**

* Explore and analyze structured, analysis-ready customer data feeds (including claims, authorizations, eligibility, and clinical documentation) to extract key insights.
* Investigate data quality issues, anomalies, and inconsistencies, collaborating closely with Engineering and customer teams to ensure accurate reporting.
* Partner with Data Engineering to define business logic and data requirements needed for downstream analytical workflows.
* Build checks that catch data issues before they reach customer reporting.

**Product Support**

* Turn recurring customer analyses into standard metrics and reports that can be built into the platform.
* Help define metric logic and business rules so numbers are consistent across customers and reports.
* Give Product, Engineering, and Data Science feedback on what customers ask for and where current reporting falls short.

**Collaborate Across the Company**

* Work with Data Science, Product, Engineering, Clinical Operations, and Customer Success on customer engagements and internal projects.
* Be a go-to resource on how our customers’ data is structured and what it can and can’t support.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 4+ years of experience in healthcare analytics or a related analytical role.
* Hands-on experience with healthcare claims data; experience with authorization, eligibility, or clinical data is a plus.
* Strong SQL skills, working proficiency in Python for data analysis, and proven ability to independently answer complex, ambiguous analytical questions.
* Experience building dashboards and reports in a BI or notebook tool.
* Solid understanding of descriptive statistics and common healthcare metrics (e.g., PMPM, utilization per 1,000, cost per member).
* Careful about data quality, with a habit of checking results before sharing them.
* Ability to explain analytical findings clearly to non-technical audiences.
* Proven experience working directly with customers or external stakeholders is required.
* Comfortable working in ambiguity and building processes from the ground up.
* Healthcare payer, provider, or health technology experience strongly preferred. Behavioral health experience is a plus.
* Exceptional references from colleagues and former managers.

**Why This Role Is Unique**

At Onos, Analysts aren’t a back-office reporting function.

You’ll work directly with health plan customers, see how your analyses inform their decisions, and help shape the reporting built into the Onos platform.

If you like digging into messy healthcare data, getting the numbers right, and seeing your work used by customers, we’d love to talk.

**Benefits & Perks**

* 3x per week in office (Mon/Tues/Thurs) in San Francisco, Financial District
* Unlimited vacation policy
* Paid parental leave
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Pre-tax commuter benefits
* 401(k)
* Significant equity as an early employee
* Direct mentorship from experienced founders
* Ground-floor opportunity to help build both the product and company
* Regular team events and off-sites
* Company-provided equipment and home office setup
* In-office lunches and snacks provided

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at On

As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

  

We are seeking an exceptiona **l** Revenue and Pricing Finance Analyst to join our Sales Finance Revenue Analytics team, based in our Santa Clara office. As part of the Product FP&A team, you will support critical activities and data products related to revenue, pricing, and rebates. This is a unique opportunity requiring proven experience with financial concepts, business processes, and data analysis.

  

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Develop and maintain data models for pricing and rebate analysis, consolidating and curating data from multiple systems into a single source of truth.
* Collaborate with multi-functional teams to find opportunities for process optimization, automation, and standardization.
* Prepare revenue analysis and reporting, maintaining the highest standards of data integrity, quality, and compliance with relevant regulations.
* Evolve reporting processes from ad-hoc analyses and prototypes to production-ready, systematized workflows.
Develop a thorough understanding of our business and processes to inform our data strategy.  

  

**What we need to see:**

* 5+ years of experience in Finance, FP&A, or a similar function (e.g. Business Operations) supporting top line revenue.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Economics, Business Analytics, Data Science, or Engineering. MBA or equivalent experience is a plus.
* Experience and proficiency with Excel, SQL, ETL development, BI Tools (e.g. Tableau or PowerBI), and Data Platforms (e.g. Databricks or Snowflake).
* Advanced financial modeling and reconciliation skills, with the ability to move fluidly between detailed analysis and big-picture storytelling.
* Highly motivated self-starter with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment, managing multiple priorities and functional areas.
Demonstrable ability to communicate effectively to audiences across a wide spectrum of seniority and technical acumen.  

  

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Industry-specific experience in computer hardware or data center components.
* Experience applying accounting principles to revenue reporting and analytics.
* Experience with quarter-end activities, external reporting, audit compliance, or SOX controls.
Knowledge or experience in Salesforce, SAP COPA, SAP SD, SAP BPC.  

  

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 124,000 USD - 195,500 USD for Level 3, and 144,000 USD - 230,000 USD for Level 4.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
***Maximize your potential. Minimize your footprint.***

Nortek Data Center Cooling builds the systems that keep modern data centers running — from liquid cooling to large‑scale air solutions. Our work supports some of the world’s most demanding AI and hyperscale environments, and we solve those challenges with engineering depth and practical execution.

We keep things simple here. We communicate early, stay close to the details, and follow through. When issues come up, we address them directly, not with layers of process. Customers count on us because we do what we say and we keep projects moving.

Our culture is hands‑on and collaborative. People take ownership, move quickly, and help each other. If you like working with teammates who are straightforward and accountable, you’ll feel at home.

With the backing of Madison Air, we have the scale, stability, and manufacturing footprint to support complex, high‑growth programs.

**Position Summary**

The Program Manager serves as the day-to-day cross-functional integrator and accountability mechanism for customer commitments on assigned programs at Nortek Data Center Cooling. This role drives flawless execution across the full program lifecycle—from opportunity identification through completion of product commissioning.

Reporting to the Vice President of Program Management, the Program Manager coordinates Engineering, Test, Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, Commercial, Finance, and Service teams to meet schedule, cost, quality, and customer commitments, while these functions continue to own execution within their respective areas. This is a hands-on execution role accountable for program-level P&L execution and customer commitments—delivering revenue, margin, cost, cash, schedule, change orders, and overall program performance. Success requires strong critical-path management, cross-functional influence, and clear communication with both internal stakeholders and external customers. The Program Manager maintains direct customer contact on program execution and is accountable for the financial health of the program, while the Sales Account Executive remains the primary customer contact and owns customer communication, negotiation, and pricing strategy.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Program Execution & Schedule Management**
-------------------------------------------

* Own end-to-end execution of assigned customer programs from opportunity identification through completion of product commissioning.
* Build, maintain, and drive the integrated program schedule with a relentless focus on critical-path items and dependencies across engineering, procurement, fabrication, assembly, test, shipping, installation, and commissioning.
* Lead recurring program cadence meetings, ensuring clear ownership, decisions, and follow-through on action items.
* Coordinate engineering release, drawing approval cycles, long-lead procurement, fabrication, assembly, testing, customer acceptance, installation, and commissioning milestones per the standardized program workflow.
* Escalate schedule risks and cross-functional roadblocks promptly, with proposed mitigation paths.

**Customer Coordination & Communication**
-----------------------------------------

* Maintain direct customer contact on program execution matters, while the Sales Account Executive remains the primary customer point of contact and owns customer communication and negotiation.
* Provide clear, proactive, and honest program status communications—schedule, milestones, risks, and change orders—to internal leadership and, in coordination with the Sales Account Executive, to the customer.
* Build strong working relationships with customer counterparts; understand their pain points, priorities, and success metrics.
* Represent the voice of the customer inside Nortek DCC and the voice of Nortek DCC to the customer with balance and integrity.

**Program-Level P&L and Contract Management**
---------------------------------------------

* Accountable for the financial health of the program and for program-level P&L execution and customer commitments—delivering revenue, margin, cost, cash, schedule, change orders, and overall program performance against the approved deal model and budget. Sales remains responsible for pricing strategy.
* Manage change orders end-to-end—identify scope changes, quantify impact, and drive internal approvals and execution—partnering with the Sales Account Executive, who leads customer negotiation.
* Monitor contract obligations, deliverables, and customer commitments; ensure Nortek DCC meets its obligations.
* Proactively identify risks to program profitability and partner with Commercial, Finance, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and Service to mitigate them.

**Risk Management**
-------------------

* Apply the standardized risk identification, escalation, and mitigation process to every assigned program.
* Maintain a live program risk register with clear ownership, mitigation actions, due dates, and status.
* Drive critical risks to closure on time, targeting 90%+ on-time closure across the program portfolio.
* Escalate top risks to the VP of Program Management with recommended actions; ensure high-risk issues have documented mitigation plans and appropriate visibility.

**Installation, Commissioning & Service Coordination**
------------------------------------------------------

* Ensure Service has visibility to installation schedules and customer requirements.
* Ensure field resources, parts, and support plans are aligned with program commitments.
* Coordinate and escalate warranty issues, field modifications, or customer concerns.
* Track financial and customer impacts associated with post-delivery issues.

* Remain engaged whenever there are material issues impacting customer commitments, schedule, economics, or customer satisfaction; support formal handoff to Service when programs are running smoothly.
* Service continues to own service

**Type**: Full-time, Permanent

**Travel:** As needed, approximately once per month to client locations in California

**About Cutter:**

For nearly 30 years, and with a global presence, we’ve combined expert consulting with proprietary research and industry benchmarking to help top-tier investment firms make smarter, faster decisions. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

**Be part of a team that makes a real difference.**

Job Description :

**This is a full-time remote position that can be located anywhere in the U.S.**

As an OE Collision Network Implementation Manager, you will help support certified collision repair networks for leading automotive manufacturers. In this customer-facing role, you'll review applications, verify shop equipment and training requirements, conduct virtual audits, and guide collision repair facilities on maintaining their certification status. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with collision repair, estimating, production management, or automotive service experience who wants to leverage their industry knowledge in a technology-driven, remote work environment.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Review and process applications from collision repair facilities seeking certification within manufacturer-sponsored collision networks.
* Verify customer-submitted tooling, equipment, and training requirements against network standards.
* Conduct virtual audits and customer meetings using video conferencing tools to validate equipment and compliance requirements.
* Manage annual certification renewals and ongoing compliance reviews for existing network members.
* Maintain accurate records and documentation within Salesforce and other company systems.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for collision repair facilities regarding certification requirements and network participation.
* Partner with internal teams to support network growth and customer success initiatives.
* Assist with other projects and operational initiatives as assigned.

**Skills and Abilities**

* Working knowledge of collision repair shop operations, equipment, and tooling.
* Strong customer service and communication skills with the ability to conduct virtual meetings confidently.
* Ability to review information carefully and ensure accuracy and compliance.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
* Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM platforms preferred.
* Strong organizational and time management skills in a remote work environment.
* Ability to build credibility and rapport with collision repair professionals and automotive industry customers.
* Comfortable learning new systems, processes, and technologies.

Qualifications:

Amentum is a global leader in advanced engineering and innovative technology solutions, trusted by the United States and its allies to address their most significant and complex challenges in science, security and sustainability. The **Senior Cybersecurity Risk Analyst** is a US remote, senior individual contributor position within the Cybersecurity Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GR&C) team. This role owns the enterprise's cyber risk assessment work: evaluating activities and operational decisions across the enterprise and articulating the resulting cyber risk to business leadership against the enterprise's risk appetite.

The work is assessment heavy. The Senior Cybersecurity Risk Analyst examines technology and operational decisions for cyber risk that compliance-driven review alone does not surface, then frames that risk in business terms so GR&C and leaders can make informed accept, mitigate, or remediate decisions. The role is a twin to the Compliance function: where Compliance concentrates on the administrative work of demonstrating conformance to mandatory controls, this role works alongside it to drive cohesive cyber risk management across the enterprise regardless of which framework imposes a given requirement.

Consistent with the GR&C charter, the role helps protect Amentum against internal and external cyber threats and helps set, improve, and make recommendations on the enterprise security program based on industry best practices, regulations, policies, standards, and guidelines. GR&C surfaces and advises on risk so that business and operational owners can make informed decisions. This person must be technical enough to recognize risk in networking, cloud, endpoint, and identity decisions made by engineering and IT, and credible enough that their risk judgments carry weight with those teams and with leadership. The role acts on behalf of the entire enterprise rather than any single team, contract, or project, and brings attention to risk without hindering the business. **This position is US remote telework and requires US Citizenship.**

**About The Fedcap Group**
--------------------------

For more than 90 years, Fedcap has been turning possibility into reality. As a global nonprofit serving more than 335,000 people each year across the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and Australia, we open doors to economic mobility through innovative, evidence-based solutions in education, workforce development, health, and economic development. Join us and experience The Power of Possible, where your work creates real opportunities for people facing barriers to economic well-being and helps build stronger communities every day.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

Reporting to the Director of Strategic Intelligence and Pipeline, the Market Intelligence Analyst is responsible for generating high-quality leads and producing the external market insight required to build tomorrow's pipeline.

The postholder will proactively identify and assess potential opportunities through commissioner and funder intelligence, policy and procurement scanning, competitor analysis and market sizing. The role will turn external signals into clear lead briefs and actionable intelligence for Growth, Opportunity Management and senior decision-makers.

**Key Responsibilities**

##### **Lead Generation & Early Opportunity Identification**

Generate a continuous flow of credible, evidence-based leads across priority sectors, services and geographies. Identify opportunities early enough to support market shaping, relationship development and organizational readiness.

* Proactively scan target markets for new contracts, funding streams, grants, frameworks and adjacent growth opportunities.
* Monitor procurement portals, prior information notices, funding announcements, market engagement activity and published commissioning plans.
* Create and maintain a forward-looking opportunity radar, including expected value, timing, buyer, route to market and source evidence.
* Prepare initial lead briefs and assess strategic relevance, accessibility, maturity and next actions.
* Route viable leads to the Director and relevant Growth leaders for screening, ownership and progression into the enterprise pipeline.
* Track the conversion of intelligence-generated leads into qualified opportunities and use outcomes to improve lead-generation activity.

##### **Commissioner & Funder Intelligence**

Build a current, practical understanding of commissioners, funders and procurement bodies to strengthen lead generation and market positioning. Translate published priorities, budgets and commissioning intentions into clear implications for growth.

* Research commissioner and funder strategies, priorities, budgets and future commissioning intentions.
* Develop and maintain profiles of priority commissioners, funders and procurement authorities.
* Track consultations, market engagement events, pipeline publications and recommissioning cycles.
* Provide targeted intelligence to support Executive Directors with market-shaping and relationship activity.

##### **Policy, Funding & Procurement Scanning**

Monitor external developments that may create, accelerate or constrain future opportunities. Provide concise alerts and analysis so the organization can respond to policy change, new funding and procurement reform.

* Monitor relevant policy, legislative, regulatory, economic and funding developments across priority jurisdictions.
* Assess the likely impact of external changes on demand, commissioning models and market accessibility.

**Position Title:** Pipeline Intelligence Analyst

**Location:** 633 3 rd Ave, New York, NY 10017

**Reports to:** Director of Strategic Intelligence and Pipeline

**Compensation** : $82,000 - $92,000/Yr ( *based on experience and qualifications* )

**About The Fedcap Group**

For more than 90 years, Fedcap has been turning possibility into reality. As a global nonprofit serving more than 335,000 people each year across the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and Australia, we open doors to economic mobility through innovative, evidence-based solutions in education, workforce development, health, and economic development. Join us and experience The Power of Possible, where your work creates real opportunities for people facing barriers to economic well-being and helps build stronger communities every day.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

Reporting to the Director of Strategic Intelligence and Pipeline, the Pipeline Intelligence Analyst is responsible for maintaining a trusted enterprise pipeline and producing the analysis required to manage growth performance, opportunity priorities and portfolio risk.

The postholder will drive CRM discipline, data quality, reporting and dashboarding, while providing insight on conversion, must-win priorities, recompete exposure, concentration and pipeline risk. The role will turn pipeline data into clear management information that supports governance, financial alignment and action.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Pipeline Data Quality & CRM Discipline**
------------------------------------------

Maintain a complete, accurate and trusted enterprise pipeline by applying agreed data, stage and governance standards. Work directly with opportunity owners to resolve gaps and ensure records reflect the current position.

* Monitor Salesforce and associated pipeline records for completeness, accuracy, currency and consistency.
* Validate opportunity value, stage, timing, probability, ownership, next steps and supporting evidence.
* Follow up missing or overdue updates with opportunity owners and track resolution of data-quality issues.
* Apply agreed pipeline definitions, entry and exit criteria and mandatory data standards.
* Produce data-quality reports and identify recurring control or adoption issues.

**Pipeline Reporting & Dashboards**
-----------------------------------

Produce clear, reliable management information that gives leaders visibility of pipeline value, maturity, movement and risk. Maintain dashboards and reporting packs that support action and decision-making.

* Prepare regular pipeline dashboards, KPI reports, review packs and executive summaries.
* Report pipeline value by stage, geography, service line, customer, owner and expected decision date.
* Highlight material movements, stalled opportunities, overdue actions and changes in assumptions.
* Maintain consistent reporting logic, definitions and reconciliations across reports.
* Improve reporting efficiency through appropriate dashboarding, automation and standard templates.

**Pipeline Reviews & Governance Support**
-----------------------------------------

Coordinate the information and analysis required for effective pipeline governance. Ensure review forums have accurate records, clear actions and timely follow-through.

* Prepare agendas, analysis and opportunity information for pipeline and portfolio reviews.
* Identify records that do not meet qualification, evidence or stage-gate requirements.
* Capture decisions, actions, owners and deadlines arising from governance reviews.
* Monitor agreed actions and escalate unresolved data or process issues to the Director.
* Maintain the governance calendar and supporting documentation.

**Prioritization & Portfolio Analysis**
---------------------------------------

Provide analysis that supports evidence-based opportunity prioritization and must-win management. Help leaders understand pipeline balance, resource implications and alignment with growth strategy.

* Maintain prioritization scores, must-win reporting and portfolio views using agreed criteria.
* Analyze pipeline balance across sectors, commissioners, territories, service lines and maturity stages.
* Identify concentration, diversification and coverage trends within the opportunity portfolio.
* Prepare analytical inputs for resource allocation and investment discussions.
* Track whether priority opportunities continue to meet the evidence required for their status.

**Conversion, Win/Loss & Performance Insight**
----------------------------------------------

Track how opportunities progress through the lifecycle and identify where conversion is improving or weakening. Convert performance data into practical insight for governance and continuous improvement.

* Calculate and monitor stage conversion, win rates, pipeline velocity and ageing using agreed definitions.
* Analyze bottlenecks, stalled opportunities and patterns in progression or attrition.
* Support win/loss reviews by preparing data, trends and opportunity histories.
* Compare performance across relevant portfolio dimensions without overstating conclusions.
* Produce concise recommendations and follow-up measures arising from analysis.

**Recompete, Concentration & Pipeline Risk Insight**
----------------------------------------------------

Maintain visibility of contract expiry, recompete exposure, concentration and other risks that may affect future growth. Provide early warning of coverage gaps and changes that require management action.

* Maintain the recompete and contract-expiry view and reconcile it with the active pipeline.
* Monitor pipeline maturity, probability, timing, dependencies and key risk indicators.
* Analyze exposure by commissioner, funder, contract, market, geography and service line.
* Identify future revenue gaps, weak pipeline coverage and material changes in portfolio risk.
* Support scenario and mitigation analysis with Finance, Growth and Opportunity Management.

Founded in 1989 and headquartered in Reston, Virginia, SOSi is a private defense and government solutions business specializing in advanced technology systems and mission support. Its capabilities include data science, software development, network engineering, intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR), and logistics.

 **Job Description**

SOSi is seeking a Program Manager (Intelligence). The Program Manager leads a nationwide intelligence research and analysis program supporting federal law enforcement and national security operations. As the primary point of contact with government contracting officers, CORs, and senior mission leadership, the Program Manager is accountable for contract performance, workforce management, and mission outcomes. Based in the Washington, DC area, the Program Manager will lead a large, geographically distributed team of cleared intelligence analysts. Responsibilities will include staffing coordination, recruiting and retention, quality control, performance monitoring, and personnel transitions. The Program Manager will set consistent analytic and operational standards across headquarters and field locations, track performance metrics, resolve staffing and performance issues quickly, and deliver timely status and staffing reports. They will also lead the program through stand-up and steady-state operations, coordinating with corporate recruiting, security, and transition teams to keep the workforce fully staffed and mission-ready. This position is for an experienced leader who builds trusted relationships with government stakeholders, manages competing priorities in a fast-paced operational environment, and maintains high standards of accountability.

* Conduct intelligence research and all-source analysis to support federal immigration enforcement and national security operations, integrating information from law enforcement, government, commercial, and open sources.

* Produce finished intelligence products, including assessments, bulletins, target packages, and briefing materials, that meet established analytic tradecraft, sourcing, and quality standards.
* Perform trend and threat analysis to identify emerging patterns, risks, and priorities affecting enforcement operations at the national, regional, and local levels.
* Conduct network and relationship analysis to identify associations among individuals, organizations, and activities, using link-analysis and visualization tools to present findings.
* Perform intelligence gap analysis and recommend collection priorities and research strategies to address unanswered intelligence requirements.
* Provide direct analytical support to field operations, including research on short timelines, support to operational planning, and responses to requests for information from field personnel.
* Prepare and deliver oral and written briefings to Government leadership, operational personnel, and partner agencies, tailoring content to the audience.

With all the information available today, it takes a skilled intelligence analyst to know how to find and interpret the best data to give their clients the right answers. With the critical decisions made in our military every day, we need an intel analyst like you to do just that. As an All-Source Intelligence Analyst, you use your specialized technical intelligence, military or government experience and your attention to detail to develop intelligence products, including intelligence papers and briefings, to give your client the actionable intelligence and context they need. If you have strong analytical skills and a problem-solving mindset, we have an opportunity to use those skills to safeguard our warfighters and enable our military and national leaders to shape national security policy.

As an intelligence analyst on our team, you will help your client identify and understand foreign and asymmetric threats to U.S. Army plans, processes, and other activities as directed. You will have the opportunity to explore new data sources and combine information from disparate sources to develop tradecraft as you build assessments and briefings for the intelligence community and senior leaders and policymakers. You will help your team provide intelligence-informed, adversary-centric insights that may be separate and distinct from other established channels of military advice or finished intelligence products and analysis prepared for senior leaders. You will assist your team to challenge intelligence assumptions, sometimes providing alternative analysis from the perspective of adversaries to inform ASL decision making. As the authority on your portfolios, your client will look to you for time-critical recommendations, often under pressure.

This is a chance to grow your expertise, develop new skills in intelligence analysis, production, and briefing senior leaders, and share your methodologies with other analysts. **Job description**
-------------------

**About this role**

Forward Deployed Business Analyst

**Your team**

The BlackRock Transformation Office (BTO) is a global group of change professionals that delivers strategic transformation to help make BlackRock greater than the sum of its parts. We drive 1BLK outcomes by continuously connecting and being students of the firm’s people, processes and technology.

We are a versatile team with varied experiences and backgrounds, motivated by the challenge of finding solutions that benefit BlackRock and our clients. In BTO, we focus on developing our people, strengthening leadership and delivery skills, and broadening firm and industry knowledge. Projects and roles consider both successful delivery and individual development objectives and career aspirations.

**Your role and impact**

The Forward Deployed Business Analyst will work in cross-functional teams to reimagine, innovate and scale solutions that drive growth and operating models within the firm.

This is not a traditional business analysis role centered on gathering requirements and handing them to technology. The role combines business analysis, product discovery, business architecture and hands-on prototyping to turn ambiguous problems into tangible solutions that business users and engineers can test and refine together.

Successful candidates will combine the structured thinking of a business analyst, the prioritization instincts of a product owner, the enterprise perspective of a business architect and the bias to action of a hands-on builder.

**Your responsibilities**

In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:

* Take ownership of complex, ambiguous business problems and rapidly translate them into testable solution hypotheses with measurable outcomes.
* Build structured business context covering terminology, entities, relationships, decision logic, data dependencies, controls and exceptions for use by subject matter experts, AI tools and engineering teams.
* Decompose business processes into explicit logic, controls and exception paths for implementation by technology teams.
* Create functional prototypes using AI-enabled development capabilities to discover requirements, challenge assumptions and validate future-state processes, data, policies and controls.
* Shape the target operating model, including ownership of data, governance, controls, roles and exception management.
* Partner continuously with business experts, product managers, engineers, architects, data specialists and control partners from discovery through implementation.
* **Develop measurable project objectives, drive consensus, and communicate plans, progress and outcomes effectively to stakeholders and management across levels.**

**Your experience**

* 3–5 years of relevant work experience in transformation, product delivery, business architecture, technology-enabled change or a comparable discipline.
* Experience in business architecture and operating-model design, connecting solutions to business capabilities, roles, governance, policy ownership, controls and exception handling.
* Proficiency in prototype-led problem solving and rapidly converting ambiguous business problems into functional prototypes that stakeholders can see, test and challenge.
* Expertise using AI-enabled development environments to accelerate analysis, prototyping, requirements definition and testing, including critically evaluating generated outputs, maintaining traceability and understanding where human judgment remains essential.
* Experience with iterative delivery and hands-on ownership through cycles of analysis, experimentation and solution shaping.
* Experience in financial services or a similar industry.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate objectives and influence outcomes.
  

  

**Our benefits**

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of employee benefits including: retirement investment and tools designed to help you in building a sound financial future; access to education reimbursement; comprehensive resources to support your physical health and emotional well-being; family support programs; and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

**Our hybrid work model**

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**

  

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. new_jobs.title: Privacy Operations Analyst
new_jobs.description:
**Job Description**

Key Responsibilities

Privacy Program Management & Reporting

* Structure and maintain privacy operations work in Azure DevOps (ADO), Jira, or similar work-management tools, including custom work item types and fields mapped to privacy concepts (jurisdiction, data type, risk tier).

* Build and maintain KPI dashboards and reporting (e.g., DSAR SLA compliance, assessment backlog age, incident response times) for privacy program leadership, using ADO Analytics, Power BI, or similar tools.

* Track cross-functional privacy work items that depend on Legal, Security, and Product teams, and proactively surface bottlenecks and at-risk items.

* Coordinate responses to data subject access requests (DSARs) and other data subject rights requests, ensuring timely resolution within statutory timelines across jurisdictions.

Track and report on privacy program metrics and KPIs for leadership and relevant stakeholders.  



Privacy Risk Assessments

* Conduct and document privacy impact assessments (PIAs), data protection impact assessments (DPIAs), and transfer impact assessments (TIAs) for new products, features, and vendor engagements.

* Support automated assessment workflows that trigger and assign PIAs/DPIAs based on risk-based conditional logic (data type, processing purpose, jurisdiction, vendor risk tier), escalating high-risk triggers for senior review.

Support efforts to reduce manual effort in assessment scoring and risk rating, applying sound judgment on what can be automated versus what must remain human-reviewed.  



Data Mapping & ROPA Maintenance

* Maintain and update the company’s records of processing activities (ROPA), tying outputs directly to data mapping and risk assessment findings.

* Support data discovery and data flow mapping efforts across the organization’s systems, environments, and third-party integrations, leveraging data discovery tooling where available.

Support an ongoing ownership and maintenance model for the data map/ROPA, including monitoring for drift as systems or vendors change and reconciling against discovery tool outputs.  



Privacy Compliance & Risk Management

* Monitor and track changes in privacy regulations across jurisdictions, and support compliance with key regulations including UK GDPR/EU GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, PIPEDA, and other applicable regimes.

* Support privacy incident response and breach notification processes, including incident documentation and breach register maintenance.

Support privacy audits and assessments of internal processes and third-party vendors.  



Privacy-by-Design & Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Support the intake and triage of privacy-related inquiries from internal stakeholders and customers.

* Partner with Legal, Information Security, IT, Product, and Business teams to support the integration of privacy-by-design principles into the product development cycle.

* Assist with privacy training content delivery and tracking across the business.

Support vendor and partner reviews to ensure contractual privacy obligations are met, and help identify current sub-processors for contractual documentation updates.  



Documentation & Governance

* Contribute to internal privacy policy, procedure, and operational playbook documentation.

* Maintain privacy metrics, dashboards, and reports for leadership and relevant stakeholders.

Provide guidance and quality review to junior privacy operations team members on documentation and process adherence.  



Required Qualifications

* 5-7 years of experience in a privacy, compliance, legal operations, or similar role, supporting a global or multi-jurisdictional privacy program.

* Working knowledge of UK GDPR/EU GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, PIPEDA, and other applicable global data subject rights frameworks.

* Hands-on experience with privacy management platforms (e.g., OneTrust, TrustArc) configuring or running DSAR, PIA/DPIA, and data mapping workflows.

* Experience using work-management tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jira) to structure and track privacy operations work, including building reporting dashboards and KPIs for leadership.

* Exposure to or experience with automation of privacy workflows (e.g., Power Automate, API integrations between privacy platforms and ticketing systems) to reduce manual effort in DSAR, assessment, and data mapping processes.

* Understanding of data discovery and data mapping tooling and techniques to keep ROPA records current and minimize drift.

* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; comfortable managing multiple deadlines across time zones.

Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to brief stakeholders on program status and risk.  



Preferred Qualifications

* CIPP/E, CIPP/US, or CIPM certification, or actively pursuing.

* Experience building ADO/Jira custom work item types, boards, and Power BI or analytics dashboards for privacy KPI reporting.

* Experience with data discovery/classification tools (e.g., OneTrust Data Discovery, BigID, Collibra).

* Prior experience in a shared services, global operations, or multinational organization.

Familiarity with basic scripting or low-code automation (e.g., Power Automate) to support privacy workflow automation.  



Skills & Competencies

* Ability to work independently and collaboratively across global teams and time zones

Technical aptitude for understanding data flows, systems, and automation tooling

The successful candidate must have proven experience independently managing these specialized construction activities, with full responsibility for site execution, construction planning, subcontractor performance, productivity, quality, HSE, costs, and timely delivery.

**Experience in BOTH major earthworks/deep excavation AND piling works is mandatory.**

* **Mandatory hands-on experience in BOTH earthworks/deep excavation AND piling works.**
* Demonstrated experience managing foundation packages for high-rise residential or commercial buildings.
* Strong technical knowledge of bored piling, pile testing, shoring systems, dewatering, excavation support, and foundation preparation.

new_jobs.title: Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Lancée en 2021 avec l’ambition de devenir l’insurtech européenne de référence sur le risque cyber, Stoïk est soutenue par certains des investisseurs les plus renommés au monde et a co-construit son produit d’assurance avec des assureurs et des réassureurs de premier plan, tels que Tokio Marine HCC et Swiss Re.

Stoïk protège et assure aujourd’hui plus de 14 000 entreprises dans 7 pays européens, avec une équipe de plus de 180 collaborateurs. Notre modèle va au-delà de l’assurance cyber : nous associons la couverture à nos propres outils de sécurité, à une surveillance 24h/24 et à une équipe interne de réponse à incident qui traite plus de 150 incidents par mois. Notre mission : être le CISO de l’Europe.

**Le poste**
------------

Nous recherchons un ou une Data Analyst pour rejoindre notre équipe data. Le cœur du poste consiste à créer et à maintenir les graphiques, les chiffres et les rapports qui décrivent l’activité de l’entreprise.

* En tant que startup en forte croissance, Stoïk ajuste en permanence sa stratégie commerciale au rythme du lancement de nouveaux produits et de l’ouverture de nouveaux marchés. Les nouvelles fonctionnalités de notre logiciel ont besoin d’indicateurs pour être évaluées. L’analyse de données est donc nécessaire aussi bien pour mesurer le succès du plan en cours que pour préparer le suivant.
* Parce qu’elle commercialise des contrats d’assurance, l’entreprise doit suivre son portefeuille afin d’ajuster sa souscription. L’assurance est un produit atypique : le prix facturé est connu d’avance, mais pas le coût pour l’assureur. Un reporting détaillé est donc indispensable pour suivre d’un côté les primes, de l’autre les sinistres.
* Acteur de la cybersécurité, Stoïk collecte par ailleurs une grande quantité de données via ses scanners d’infrastructure et de vulnérabilités. Pour prévenir les incidents et réagir vite, ces données doivent être exploitées afin, par exemple, d’alerter les assurés concernés dès la publication d’une nouvelle faille critique.

**Principales missions**
------------------------

* Échanger avec les autres équipes, en particulier les équipes produit, opérations, finance et customer success, pour identifier les indicateurs qu’elles ont besoin de suivre. Cela suppose de comprendre nos processus produit, commerciaux et assurantiels.
* Écrire les transformations nécessaires au calcul de ces indicateurs à partir de nos données brutes. La fiabilité est primordiale. Ces calculs tournant régulièrement, les autres membres de l’équipe data vous aideront à traiter les enjeux d’optimisation.
* Choisir, pour chaque grandeur, les chiffres et les visualisations les plus adaptés. Une donnée n’est éclairante que si elle est présentée avec clarté, et un graphique compréhensible d’un seul coup d’œil fait toute la différence.
* Travailler sur les droits d’accès aux données, afin que chacun dispose des informations dont il a besoin tout en limitant l’exposition inutile aux données sensibles.
* Accompagner les utilisateurs avancés pour qu’ils construisent leurs propres tableaux de bord en s’appuyant sur le travail de l’équipe data.

**Profil recherché**
--------------------

Sur le plan technique, nous recherchons un ou une Data Analyst avec :

* Une solide maîtrise du SQL (indispensable). Une expérience de PostgreSQL en particulier est un plus, puisque c’est là que s’effectue l’essentiel de nos transformations de données.
* Une pratique de la construction de graphiques et de visualisations avec des outils comme Metabase, Tableau, Power BI ou équivalent. Au-delà de la maîtrise d’un logiciel précis, nous cherchons une bonne compréhension de la manière de présenter des chiffres.
* L’envie d’automatiser une partie de son propre travail à l’aide d’outils d’IA.
* Une expérience préalable des outils d’analytics produit web, comme PostHog, est un plus.

**Processus de recrutement**
----------------------------

* Un premier entretien de découverte
* Un test technique à réaliser chez vous
* Un second entretien pour échanger sur les résultats du test
* Un échange avec les fondateurs

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. new_jobs.title: Staff Security Program Manager, International Security
new_jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

**What You'll Do:**
-------------------

You'll join CoreWeave's Global Security & Resilience organization to build and drive the security program supporting our rapidly expanding international footprint — including offices we operate directly and locations where we support our data center teams. You'll work closely with executive protection, the GSOC, External Affairs, and cross-functional business leaders to protect our people and operations as CoreWeave scales globally.

The Staff Security Program Manager, International Security will own and drive CoreWeave's international security program, with responsibility for global travel security, international office and site protection, global security partnerships and outreach, and support for executive protection and event security as needed. You'll partner closely with CoreWeave's Senior Manager, Corporate Security, who leads the domestic program, to coordinate standards, incident response, and shared protective operations.

This individual contributor role combines enterprise program ownership with hands-on operational execution. You'll design and stand up a world-class travel security program — pre-travel risk assessments, traveler tracking and duty-of-care protocols, in-country support, and emergency response for employees traveling or working abroad. You'll also establish security standards for CoreWeave's growing international office footprint and the locations where CoreWeave supports its data center teams, in partnership with Facilities, Data Center Operations, and local leadership.

A significant part of this role is external-facing: building and sustaining global partnerships with law enforcement, intelligence services, diplomatic security, industry peers, and trusted local security providers in the countries where CoreWeave operates. You'll also provide tactical, hands-on support for executive protection and event security as needed — including advances, logistics coordination, and on-the-ground protective coverage — both domestically and internationally.

Success in this role requires strategic thinking, cultural fluency, and sound judgment operating in ambiguous, fast-moving international environments. You must be comfortable building programs from the ground up, influencing stakeholders without direct authority, working through a network of internal teams, contractors, and in-country partners, and delivering results with limited on-the-ground infrastructure. This role has no direct reports.

**About the role:**
-------------------

* Design, build, and own CoreWeave's global travel security program, including pre-travel risk assessments, country risk ratings, traveler tracking, duty-of-care protocols, and coordination of 24/7 emergency response and evacuation support for employees traveling or working abroad.
* Develop and maintain security standards, governance, and risk assessments for CoreWeave's international office footprint and the locations where CoreWeave supports its data center teams, balancing consistent global controls with local risk, culture, and regulatory requirements.
* Build and sustain global partnerships and outreach with foreign law enforcement, intelligence, diplomatic security, and industry security counterparts, as well as trusted in-country guard force, investigative, and protective service providers.
* Serve as CoreWeave's primary international security point of contact for new-market entry and international office openings, conducting site and country risk assessments and coordinating security coverage ahead of business expansion.
* Drive program execution across internal teams, regional security partners, and contracted providers, establishing clear requirements, coordinating deliverables, and evaluating provider performance.
* Personally plan and provide tactical, hands-on support for executive protection and high-profile event security as needed, including advances, route and venue assessments, logistics coordination, and on-site protective coverage domestically and abroad.
* Translate threat, political, and protective intelligence into practical guidance for travelers, international offices, and business leaders, including country and regional travel advisories.
* Coordinate with the GSOC, the domestic Corporate Security team, and internal response teams to ensure seamless monitoring, escalation, and incident management for international employees, offices, and events.
* Develop budget recommendations, manage approved international security program spend, and oversee the vendor and travel-security-provider portfolio and technology roadmap, including traveler tracking and mass-notification tools.
* Advise senior leaders and cross-functional partners in People, Legal, Real Estate, and Data Center Operations on international security risk and risk-informed business decisions.
* Establish metrics to evaluate program effectiveness, traveler safety outcomes, partner performance, and risk reduction across the international portfolio, and use findings to drive program improvements.

**Who You Are:**
----------------

* You have 10+ years of experience across international security, travel risk management, executive protection, or protective intelligence — ideally including government, law enforcement, military, or corporate security experience with an international or liaison component.
* You have direct, hands-on experience building or running a corporate travel security program, i
